en.s: In 351–352, the Jews of the Roman province of Syria Palaestina revolted against the rule of Constantius Gallus, brother-in-law of Emperor Constantius II and caesar of the eastern part of the Roman Empire. The revolt, which occurred during the Roman civil war of 350–353, was crushed by Gallus' general Ursicinus.
en.n: The Jewish revolt against Constantius Gallus breaks out after his arrival at Antioch.

zh.t: 君士坦提乌斯·加卢斯时期的犹太人起义
zh.s: 351年至352年，罗马叙利亚-巴勒斯坦行省的犹太人反抗东罗马皇帝君士坦提乌斯二世的妹夫、帝国东部凯撒君士坦提乌斯·加卢斯。起义发生在350年至353年的罗马内战期间，最终被加卢斯的将领乌尔西基努斯镇压。
zh.n: 犹太人起义在君士坦提乌斯·加卢斯抵达安条克后爆发。

en.t: In Constantinople, the dome of the Hagia Sophia collapses, twenty years after its construction. Justinian I immediately orders that the dome be rebuilt
en.s: Hagia Sophia, officially the Hagia Sophia Grand Mosque, is a mosque and a major cultural and historical site in Istanbul, Turkey. It was formerly a church (360–1453) and a museum (1935–2020). The last of three church buildings to be successively erected on the site by the Eastern Roman Empire, it was completed in AD 537, becoming the world's largest interior space and among the first to employ a fully pendentive dome.

zh.t: 君士坦丁堡圣索菲亚大教堂穹顶坍塌，距建成二十年；查士丁尼一世立即下令重建
zh.s: 圣索菲亚大教堂现名圣索菲亚大清真寺，是位于土耳其伊斯坦布尔的重要文化和历史遗址。它曾先后是一座教堂（360—1453 年）和一座博物馆（1935—2020 年）。现址上的第三座教堂于公元 537 年建成，当时拥有世界上最大的室内空间，也是最早采用完整帆拱穹顶的建筑之一。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Harran took place on 7 May 1104 between the Crusader states of the Principality of Antioch and the County of Edessa, and the Seljuk Turks. It was the first major battle against the newfound Crusader states in the aftermath of the First Crusade, marking a key turning point against Frankish expansion. The battle had a disastrous effect on the Principality of Antioch as the Turks regained territory earlier lost.

zh.s: 哈兰战役于1104年5月7日爆发，交战双方是安条克公国、埃德萨伯国等十字军国家，以及塞尔柱突厥人。这是第一次十字军东征后，十字军国家遭遇的首场重大战役，也是法兰克势力扩张受挫的关键转折点。战役给安条克公国造成沉重打击，突厥人收复了此前失去的领土。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Philomelion (Philomelium in Latin, Akşehir in Turkish) was a victory of the forces of the Holy Roman Empire over the Turkish forces of the Sultanate of Rûm on 7 May 1190 during the Third Crusade. In May 1189, Holy Roman Emperor Frederick Barbarossa began his expedition to the Holy Land as part of the Third Crusade to recover the city of Jerusalem from the forces of Saladin.

zh.s: 菲洛梅利翁战役（拉丁语称Philomelium，土耳其语称阿克谢希尔）于1190年5月7日爆发，是第三次十字军东征期间神圣罗马帝国军队战胜罗姆苏丹国土耳其军队的一场战役。1189年5月，神圣罗马帝国皇帝腓特烈·巴巴罗萨开始参加第三次十字军东征，试图从萨拉丁军队手中夺回耶路撒冷。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.t: In France, the Second Council of Lyon opens; it ratified a decree to regulate the election of the Pope
en.s: The Second Council of Lyon was the fourteenth ecumenical council of the Roman Catholic Church, convoked on 31 March 1272 and convened in Lyon, Kingdom of Arles (in modern France), in 1274. Pope Gregory X presided over the council, called to act on a pledge by Byzantine emperor Michael VIII to reunite the Eastern church with the West.

zh.t: 第二次里昂公会议在法国开幕，并批准规范教皇选举的法令
zh.s: 第二次里昂公会议是罗马天主教会第十四次大公会议，由教皇格列高利十世主持。会议于 1272 年 3 月 31 日召集，并于 1274 年在阿尔勒王国的里昂（今法国境内）召开。会议旨在落实拜占庭皇帝米海尔八世承诺与西方教会重新合一的誓约。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The War of L'Aquila (Italian: Guerra dell'Aquila) was a conflict in 15th-century Italy. It started in 1423 as a personal conflict against the condottiero Braccio da Montone and the city of L'Aquila in Abruzzo, but later turned into a national conflict when the forces of the Duchy of Milan, the Republic of Florence, the Papal States, and the Kingdom of Naples were also involved.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拉奎拉战争（意大利语：Guerra dell'Aquila）是15世纪意大利的一场冲突。1423年，雇佣兵队长布拉乔·达·蒙托内与阿布鲁佐的拉奎拉城发生私人冲突；后来，米兰公国、佛罗伦萨共和国、教皇国和那不勒斯王国的军队也卷入其中，冲突演变为全国性战争。
zh.n: 此条记录的是源信息框所列事件的开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1487 siege of Málaga was an action during the Reconquest of Spain in which the Catholic Monarchs of Spain conquered the city of Mālaqa from the Emirate of Granada. The siege lasted about four months. It was the first conflict in which ambulances, or dedicated vehicles for the purpose of carrying injured persons, were used.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1487年马拉加围城战是西班牙收复失地运动期间的一场战役。西班牙天主教双王从格拉纳达埃米尔国手中攻下马拉加城。围城持续约四个月。这是首次使用救护车或专门运送伤员的车辆的冲突。
zh.n: 此条记录的是源信息框所列事件的开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Burning of Edinburgh in 1544 by an English army was the first major action of the war of the Rough Wooing. The Provost of Edinburgh was compelled to allow the English to sack Leith and Edinburgh, and the city was burnt on 7 May. However, the Scottish artillery within Edinburgh Castle harassed the English forces, who had neither the time nor the resources to besiege the Castle.

zh.s: 1544年，英格兰军队焚烧爱丁堡，这是粗暴求婚战争中的首次重大军事行动。爱丁堡市长被迫允许英军劫掠利斯和爱丁堡，城市于5月7日被焚毁。不过，爱丁堡城堡内的苏格兰炮兵持续袭扰英军；英军没有足够时间和资源围攻城堡。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Happo was a naval engagement on May 7, 1592, one of the three Joseon naval campaigns of 1592 conducted by Korean admiral Yi Sun-sin during Japanese invasions of Korea (1592-1598) against the Japanese forces of Toyotomi Hideyoshi. These campaigns made Yi a legendary figure in Korean history. The campaigns of Yi were vital in halting the Japanese invasion.

zh.s: 闲山岛海战中的浦项海战于1592年5月7日爆发，是朝鲜海军将领李舜臣在日本侵朝战争（1592—1598年）期间发动的三次海上战役之一。李舜臣率军对抗丰臣秀吉的日军。这些战役让李舜臣成为朝鲜历史上的传奇人物，并对阻止日本入侵起到关键作用。

en.s: The Battle of Fushun (Chinese: 撫順之戰) was the first military conflict in the war between the Later Jin dynasty and the Ming dynasty, occurring in 1618 in Fushun. The battle ended in a decisive victory for the Later Jin and resulted in the capture of Fushun and two other nearby fortresses.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 抚顺之战（中文：撫順之戰）是后金与明朝战争中的首场军事冲突，于1618年在抚顺发生。后金取得决定性胜利，攻占抚顺及附近另外两座堡垒。
zh.n: 此条记录的是源信息框所列事件的开始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Kłecko was fought on May 7, 1656, between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth commanded by Regimentarz Stefan Czarniecki and Jerzy Sebastian Lubomirski and a Swedish force commanded by prince Adolf Johan av Pfalz-Zweibrücken. The Polish–Lithuanian force was more than 12,000 strong and consisted mostly of cavalry, while the Swedes numbered around 7,000 artillery, infantry and cavalry. The Swedes achieved a tactical victory in that they escaped destruction by the Poles, who were unable to get to the Swedish army entrenched behind the Welnianka River, and various ditches and swamps.

zh.s: 克莱茨科战役于1656年5月7日爆发，波兰立陶宛联邦军队与瑞典军队交战。波兰立陶宛联邦军由斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基和耶日·塞巴斯蒂安·卢博米尔斯基指挥，瑞典军由阿道夫·约翰·普法尔茨-茨魏布吕肯亲王指挥。波兰立陶宛联邦军超过12,000人，以骑兵为主；瑞典军约有7,000人，包括炮兵、步兵和骑兵。瑞典军取得战术胜利，成功避免被波军歼灭。波军未能越过韦尔尼安卡河以及多条壕沟和沼泽，无法接近在河后筑垒的瑞典军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle on Vrtijeljka (Serbian: бој на Вртијељци, romanized: boj na Vrtijeljci) was fought on the hill of Vrtijeljka near Cetinje between a Venetian irregular force and an advancing Ottoman force on 7 May 1685 at the start of the Morean War. The Venetian force was made up of fighters from the neighbouring areas, including the band of acclaimed hajduk Bajo Pivljanin, and several Christian tribes.

zh.s: 弗蒂耶利卡山战役（塞尔维亚语：бој на Вртијељци，拉丁转写：boj na Vrtijeljci）于1685年5月7日发生在采蒂涅附近的弗蒂耶利卡山，是莫兰战争初期的一场战斗。威尼斯非正规部队与正在推进的奥斯曼军队交战。威尼斯一方由邻近地区的战士组成，其中包括著名的哈伊杜克武装首领巴约·皮夫利亚宁所率队伍，以及数支基督教部族。

en.t: Stockholm's medieval castle Tre Kronor is destroyed by fire. It is replaced in the 18th century by the current Royal Palace
en.s: Tre Kronor (Swedish pronunciation: [ˈtreː ˈkrûːnʊr] or [ˈtreː ˈkrûːnɛr]) or Three Crowns Castle was a castle located in Stockholm, Sweden, on the site where Stockholm Palace is today. It is believed to have been a citadel that Birger Jarl built into a royal castle in the middle of the 13th century. The name "Tre Kronor" is believed to have been given to the castle during the reign of King Magnus Eriksson in the middle of the 14th century.

zh.t: 斯德哥尔摩中世纪城堡三王冠宫毁于大火，18 世纪由现今的王宫取代
zh.s: 三王冠宫（瑞典语发音：[ˈtreː ˈkrûːnʊr] 或 [ˈtreː ˈkrûːnɛr]），意为“三顶王冠”，是位于瑞典斯德哥尔摩的一座城堡，遗址即今天斯德哥尔摩王宫所在地。据信，伯爵比尔耶尔于 13 世纪中叶将一座堡垒扩建为皇家城堡。该城堡据信在 14 世纪中叶马格努斯·埃里克松国王在位时获得“三王冠宫”这一名称。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of La Gudiña, Battle of Val Gudina, or Battle of Campo Maior (Spanish: Batalla de La Gudiña; Portuguese: Batalha de Caia), was fought on 7 May 1709 near Arronches between the Spanish Bourbon army of Extremadura, under the Marquis de Bay, and the Portuguese and British, under the Huguenot Earl of Galway and the Marquis of Fronteira.

zh.s: 拉古迪尼亚战役又称瓦尔古迪纳战役或坎普马约尔战役（西班牙语：Batalla de La Gudiña；葡萄牙语：Batalha de Caia），于1709年5月7日在阿龙什附近爆发。交战双方是由贝侯爵率领的埃斯特雷马杜拉西班牙波旁军队，以及由休格诺派的戈尔韦伯爵和弗龙泰拉侯爵率领的葡萄牙和英国军队。

en.t: The city of New Orleans is founded by Jean-Baptiste Le Moyne, Sieur de Bienville
en.s: New Orleans (commonly known as NOLA or The Big Easy, among other nicknames) is a consolidated city-parish located along the Mississippi River in the U.S. state of Louisiana. With a population of 383,997 at the 2020 census, New Orleans is the most populous city in Louisiana, the second-most populous in the Deep South (after Atlanta), and the twelfth-most populous in the Southeastern United States; the New Orleans metropolitan area, with about 1 million residents, is the 59th-most populous metropolitan area in the United States.

zh.t: 让-巴蒂斯特·勒莫因·德·比安维尔建立新奥尔良
zh.s: 新奥尔良（常称 NOLA，也有“大易城”等别称）是美国路易斯安那州的一座合并市—教区，位于密西西比河沿岸。根据 2020 年人口普查，该市人口为 383,997，是路易斯安那州人口最多的城市、美国南部第二大城市（仅次于亚特兰大），也是美国东南部第十二大城市；新奥尔良都会区人口约 100 万，是美国第 59 大都会区。

en.s: The National Convention (French: Convention nationale, [kɔ̃vɑ̃sjɔ̃ nɑsjɔnal]) was the constituent assembly of the Kingdom of France for one day and of the French First Republic for its first three years during the French Revolution, following the two-year National Constituent Assembly and the one-year Legislative Assembly. The National Convention was created after the insurrection of 10 August 1792.
en.n: French Revolution: Robespierre introduces the Cult of the Supreme Being in the National Convention as the new state religion of the French First Republic.

zh.s: 国民公会（法语：Convention nationale，读音：[kɔ̃vɑ̃sjɔ̃ nɑsjɔnal]）是法国王国仅存续一天的制宪议会，也是法国大革命期间法兰西第一共和国成立后的首届议会，在历时两年的国民制宪议会和一年的立法议会之后成立。国民公会于1792年8月10日起义后成立。
zh.n: 法国大革命：罗伯斯庇尔在国民公会提出将最高主宰崇拜确立为法兰西第一共和国的新国教。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained event introduction and exact dated calendar entry

en.s: The Battle of the Îles Saint-Marcouf was an engagement fought off the Îles Saint-Marcouf near the Cotentin peninsula on the Normandy coast of France in May 1798 during the French Revolutionary Wars. In 1795 a British garrison was placed on the islands, which operated as a resupply base for Royal Navy ships cruising off the coast of Northern France. Seeking to eliminate the British presence on the islands and simultaneously test the equipment and tactics then being developed in France for a projected invasion of Britain, the French launched a massed amphibious assault on the southern island using over 50 landing ships and thousands of troops on 7 May 1798.

zh.s: 圣马库夫群岛战役于1798年5月7日在法国诺曼底海岸科唐坦半岛附近的圣马库夫群岛外海爆发，发生于法国大革命战争期间。1795年，英国在群岛上驻军，并将其作为皇家海军舰艇在法国北部海岸巡逻时的补给基地。法国希望消除英国在群岛上的存在，同时测试正在开发、准备入侵英国的装备和战术，于是出动50多艘登陆船和数千名士兵，对南岛发动大规模两栖攻击。

en.s: The Battle of Rødenes was a series of skirmishes that took place in late April and early May 1808 from Lund in Hemnes to Ørje as a result of the Swedish invasion of Norway during the Dano-Swedish War of 1808-1809.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 勒德内斯战役是一系列小规模交战，于1808年4月底至5月初在挪威卢恩德（赫姆内斯）至厄耶一带发生，起因是丹麦-瑞典战争期间瑞典入侵挪威。
zh.n: 此条记录的是源信息框所列事件的结束日期。

en.t: World premiere of Ludwig van Beethoven's Ninth Symphony in Vienna, Austria. The performance is conducted by Michael Umlauf under the composer's supervision
en.s: Ludwig van Beethoven (baptised 17 December 1770 – 26 March 1827) was a German composer, conductor, and pianist. Regarded as one of the greatest composers in the history of Western music, he was mentored during the Classical period, and his musical style was a key driver of the transition to Romantic music, and the expansion of instrumental forms such as the symphony, the piano sonata and the string quartet.

zh.t: 路德维希·范·贝多芬《第九交响曲》在奥地利维也纳首演，由迈克尔·乌姆劳夫指挥，作曲家本人在场监督
zh.s: 路德维希·范·贝多芬（受洗日期为 1770 年 12 月 17 日—1827 年 3 月 26 日）是德国作曲家、指挥家和钢琴家。他被视为西方音乐史上最伟大的作曲家之一，在古典主义时期受训，其音乐风格推动了音乐由古典主义向浪漫主义过渡，也促进了交响曲、钢琴奏鸣曲和弦乐四重奏等器乐形式的发展。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Great Natchez Tornado was a deadly tornado that hit Natchez, Mississippi, on Thursday, May 7, 1840. The tornado, while officially unrated, was the second-deadliest tornado in United States history; at least 317 people were killed and at least 109 were injured. Its 35-mile-long (56 km), 1,000-yard-wide (910 m; 3,000 ft; 0.57 mi; 0.91 km) path was marked by severe damage and uncertain estimates of casualties, though many enslaved Africans—possibly numbering in the hundreds—reportedly died on plantations in Louisiana.

zh.s: 纳奇兹大龙卷风于1840年5月7日（星期四）袭击密西西比州纳奇兹，造成大量伤亡。官方未对其强度评级，但它是美国历史上第二致命的龙卷风，至少317人死亡、至少109人受伤。龙卷风路径长35英里（56公里），宽1,000码（910米；3,000英尺；0.57英里；0.91公里），沿途严重受损，伤亡数字也难以确定。据报道，路易斯安那州种植园中有许多被奴役的非洲人遇难，人数可能达到数百。

en.s: The 1855 Newfoundland general election was held on May 7, 1855, to elect members of the 6th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Newfoundland Colony. This was the first election after responsible government was introduced in Newfoundland. The Liberal Party, now led by Philip Francis Little, formed the government. The opposition was formed by the Conservative Party led by Hugh Hoyles.

zh.s: 纽芬兰殖民地于1855年5月7日举行大选，选出纽芬兰第六届议会的议员。这是纽芬兰实行责任政府后的首次选举。菲利普·弗朗西斯·利特尔领导的自由党组建政府；休·霍伊尔斯领导的保守党成为反对党。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 7 May 1861. Incumbent President Stephen Allen Benson was the only candidate for the presidency, and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1861年5月7日举行大选。现任总统斯蒂芬·艾伦·本森是唯一的总统候选人，未经竞争再次当选。

loc: 美国南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿

en.s: The Battle of Gloucester Point, Virginia was an inconclusive exchange of cannon fire between a shore battery on the York River which was manned by Virginia (soon to be Confederate) forces and the Union gunboat USS Yankee. The action occurred on May 7, 1861, three weeks after the start of the American Civil War (Civil War) at Fort Sumter in the harbor at Charleston, South Carolina on April 14, 1861.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州格洛斯特角战役是约克河岸炮台与联邦海军炮艇“扬基号”之间的一场炮战，双方互有炮击，未分胜负。炮台由弗吉尼亚军队（很快将加入邦联）驻守。战斗发生于1861年5月7日，距美国内战于4月14日在南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿港萨姆特堡爆发约三周。

loc: 美国弗吉尼亚州新肯特县

en.s: The Battle of Eltham's Landing, also known as the Battle of Barhamsville, or West Point, took place on May 7, 1862, in New Kent County, Virginia, as part of the Peninsula Campaign of the American Civil War. Brig. Gen. William B. Franklin's Union division landed at Eltham's Landing and was attacked by two brigades of Brig. Gen. G. W. Smith's command, reacting to the threat to the Confederate army's trains on the Barhamsville Road. Franklin's movement occurred while the Confederate army was withdrawing from the Williamsburg line, but he was unable to interfere with the Confederate movement.

zh.s: 埃尔瑟姆登陆战也称巴勒姆斯维尔战役或西点战役，于1862年5月7日在弗吉尼亚州新肯特县爆发，是美国内战半岛战役的一部分。联邦军威廉·B·富兰克林准将的师在埃尔瑟姆登陆，随后遭到G·W·史密斯准将麾下两个旅的攻击。邦联军是为了应对联邦军对巴勒姆斯维尔路上军用列车的威胁而行动。富兰克林行动时，邦联军正在从威廉斯堡防线撤退，但他没能阻止邦联军撤离。

en.s: The Battle of Rocky Face Ridge was fought May 7–13, 1864, in Whitfield County, Georgia, during the Atlanta Campaign of the American Civil War. The Union army was led by Maj. Gen. William Tecumseh Sherman and the Confederate army by Gen. Joseph E. Johnston. Confederates were forced to evacuate their strong position due to a Union flanking movement. General Johnston had entrenched his army on the long, steep Rocky Face Ridge and eastward across Crow Valley. When Sherman approached, he demonstrated against this position with two columns while he sent a third one through Snake Creek Gap, to the south, to hit the Western & Atlantic Railroad at Resaca.

zh.s: 洛基面岭战役于1864年5月7日至13日在佐治亚州惠特菲尔德县进行，是美国内战亚特兰大战役的一部分。联邦军由威廉·特库姆塞·谢尔曼少将指挥，邦联军由约瑟夫·E·约翰斯顿将军指挥。联邦军从侧翼发起行动，迫使邦联军撤出坚固阵地。约翰斯顿曾将军队布防在绵长陡峭的洛基面岭及其东侧的克罗谷。谢尔曼率两路部队佯攻，同时派第三路部队经南面的蛇溪隘口前进，准备在雷萨卡袭击西大西洋铁路。

en.s: The Battle of Todd's Tavern was fought in Virginia on May 7–8, 1864, during the American Civil War.

zh.s: 托德酒馆战役于1864年5月7日至8日在弗吉尼亚州爆发，是美国内战期间的一场战役。

en.s: The Battle of the Wilderness was fought on May 5–7, 1864, during the American Civil War. It was the first battle of Lieutenant General Ulysses S. Grant's 1864 Virginia Overland Campaign against General Robert E. Lee and the Confederate Army of Northern Virginia. The fighting occurred in a wooded area near Locust Grove, Virginia, about 20 miles (32 km) west of Fredericksburg.
en.n: American Civil War: The Army of the Potomac, under General Ulysses S. Grant, breaks off from the Battle of the Wilderness and moves southwards.

zh.s: 荒野之战于1864年5月5日至7日爆发，是美国内战中的一场战役，也是尤利西斯·格兰特中将1864年弗吉尼亚陆上战役的首战，对手是罗伯特·李将军和北弗吉尼亚邦联军。战斗发生在弗吉尼亚州洛迦斯特格罗夫附近的林地，距弗雷德里克斯堡以西约20英里（32公里）。
zh.n: 美国内战：尤利西斯·格兰特将军率领的波托马克军团脱离荒野之战战场，向南进军。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 7 May 1867. The election was very close, with the House of Representatives required to decide the final outcome. Payne took office on 6 January 1868.

en.s: Local elections were held for provincial and municipal posts throughout the Philippine Archipelago from May 7, 1899. The first local elections under the American occupation were held in Baliuag, Bulacan, supervised by US General Henry W. Lawton.

en.s: The Monmouth Boroughs by-election, 1901 was a by-election held on 7 May 1901 for the British House of Commons constituency of Monmouth Boroughs. The by-election was triggered by the unseating of the Conservative Party Member of Parliament (MP) Frederick Rutherfoord Harris, as a result of an election petition alleging irregularities in election spending. The Liberal candidate was Albert Spicer, who had previously been the sitting MP but had lost in the previous general election. The result was a victory for the Conservative candidate Sheriff Joseph Lawrence, who held the seat, although the party's majority was halved.

zh.s: 1901年蒙茅斯自治市补选于1901年5月7日举行，选出英国下议院蒙茅斯自治市选区的议员。此前，保守党议员弗雷德里克·拉瑟福德·哈里斯因选举开支违规指控引发的选举请愿而失去议席，因此举行补选。自由党候选人艾伯特·斯派塞曾任该选区议员，但在上次大选中落败。最终保守党候选人、郡长约瑟夫·劳伦斯胜出并保住该席位，但保守党多数席位减半。

en.s: The 1916 Copa del Rey final was the 16th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Camp de la Indústria in Barcelona on 7 May 1916. The match was won by Athletic Bilbao, who beat Madrid FC 4–0. The star of the match was Félix Zubizarreta, who scored a hat-trick to help Athletic to a 4–0 win.

zh.s: 1916年西班牙国王杯决赛是该项杯赛的第16场决赛，于1916年5月7日在巴塞罗那工业球场举行。毕尔巴鄂竞技以4比0击败马德里FC。费利克斯·苏比萨雷塔上演帽子戏法，成为全场焦点，帮助球队取胜。

en.s: The 1920 Kiev offensive (or Kiev expedition, Polish: wyprawa kijowska) was a major part of the Polish–Soviet War. It was an attempt by the armed forces of the recently established Second Polish Republic led by Józef Piłsudski, in alliance with the Ukrainian People's Republic led by Symon Petliura, to seize the territories of modern-day Ukraine which mostly fell under Soviet control after the October Revolution as the Russian Soviet Republic. Polish and Soviet forces fought in 1919 and the Poles advanced in the disputed borderlands. In early 1920, Piłsudski concentrated on preparations for a military invasion of central Ukraine. It would result, he anticipated, in destruction of the Soviet armies and force Soviet acceptance of unilateral Polish conditions. The Poles signed an alliance, known as the Treaty of Warsaw, with the forces of the Ukrainian People's Republic. The Kiev offensive was the central component of Piłsudski's plan for a new order in Eastern Europe centered around a Polish-led Intermarium federation. The stated goal of the operation was to create a formally independent Ukraine, although its dependence on Poland was inherent to Piłsudski's plans. Ukrainians ended up fighting on both sides of the conflict. The campaign was conducted from April to July 1920. The Polish Army faced the forces of the Russian Soviet Republic. At first, the war was successful for the allied Polish and Ukrainian armies, which captured Kiev (Kyiv) on 7 May 1920, but soon the campaign's progress was dramatically reversed due to a Red Army counter-offensive, in which the 1st Cavalry Army of Semyon Budyonny played a prominent part.

zh.s: 1920年基辅攻势（又称基辅远征，波兰语：wyprawa kijowska）是波苏战争的重要组成部分。新成立的波兰第二共和国武装部队由约瑟夫·毕苏斯基领导，与西蒙·彼得留拉领导的乌克兰人民共和国结盟，试图夺取今乌克兰的领土；这些地区在十月革命后大多处于俄罗斯苏维埃共和国控制之下。波兰和苏联部队于1919年交战，波兰军队随后在争议边境地区推进。1920年初，毕苏斯基着手筹备对乌克兰中部发动军事进攻。他预计这会摧毁苏联军队，迫使苏联接受波兰单方面提出的条件。波兰与乌克兰人民共和国武装力量签订了《华沙条约》。基辅攻势是毕苏斯基构想的核心行动，目的是在东欧建立由波兰主导的“海间联邦”新秩序。行动宣称要建立一个正式独立的乌克兰，但毕苏斯基的计划本身就意味着乌克兰将依附波兰。乌克兰人最终在冲突双方都有参战。此次战役从1920年4月持续到7月，波兰军队与俄罗斯苏维埃共和国部队交战。起初，波兰和乌克兰联军进展顺利，于5月7日攻占基辅；但红军随后反攻，战局很快逆转，谢苗·布琼尼的第1骑兵集团军发挥了重要作用。

en.s: The Treaty of Moscow (Russian: Московский договор, Moskovskiy dogovor; Georgian: მოსკოვის ხელშეკრულება, moskovis khelshekruleba), signed between Soviet Russia (RSFSR) and the Democratic Republic of Georgia (DRG) in Moscow on 7 May 1920, granted de jure recognition of Georgian independence in exchange for promising not to grant asylum on Georgian soil to troops of powers hostile to Bolshevik Russia.

zh.s: 苏俄（俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国）与格鲁吉亚民主共和国于1920年5月7日在莫斯科签署《莫斯科条约》。苏俄承认格鲁吉亚独立的法律地位；作为交换，格鲁吉亚承诺不允许敌视布尔什维克俄国的势力在其境内驻军或避难。

en.s: 1921 Sultan Hussein Cup Final, was the final match of the 1920–21 Sultan Hussein Cup, was between Zamalek (El-Mokhtalat) and Sherwood Foresters from Great Britain, Zamalek won the match 2–1 after extra time (1–1 before extra time), became the 1st Egyptian team to win the cup.

zh.s: 1921年苏丹侯赛因杯决赛是1920—21赛季的最后一场比赛，由扎马雷克（原名埃尔穆赫塔拉特）对阵来自英国的舍伍德森林人队。双方在加时赛前战成1比1，扎马雷克加时赛以2比1获胜，成为首支赢得该项赛事的埃及球队。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia between 5 and 7 May 1923. There were some controversies - some lists, most remarkably Communist, were declared void before the elections because of electoral law violations, and the results gave Estonia its most fragmented parliament ever.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚议会选举于1923年5月5日至7日举行。选举前出现一些争议：部分候选名单，尤其是共产党名单，因违反选举法而被判无效。选举结果使爱沙尼亚议会党派分布比以往任何时候都更加分散。

en.s: The Parnell by-election of 1930 was a by-election in the seat of Parnell held on 7 May 1930 during the 23rd New Zealand Parliament. The by-election came about because of the resignation of the current member of parliament Harry Reginald Jenkins who chose to re-contest his seat. The seat was won by Bill Endean of the Reform Party.

zh.s: 1930年帕内尔补选于1930年5月7日举行，是新西兰第23届议会期间该选区的一场补选。时任议员哈里·雷金纳德·詹金斯辞职，决定重新竞选该席位，因此举行补选。改革党候选人比尔·恩迪恩最终胜出。

en.t: An earthquake struck northwestern Iran and southeastern Turkey, killing up to 3,000 people
en.s: The 1930 Salmas earthquake occurred on 7 May at 01:34:26 IRST in West Azerbaijan province, Iran. The earthquake, which was among Iran's largest, measured 7.1 on the moment magnitude scale and had a maximum Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). Prior to the earthquake a strong foreshock was felt fifteen hours earlier. Reports from seismologists and seismological organizations indicate that up to 3,000 fatalities may have occurred in northwest Iran and southeast Turkey.

zh.t: 伊朗西北部及土耳其东南部地震
zh.s: 1930年萨尔马斯地震于5月7日伊朗夏令时间凌晨1时34分26秒在伊朗西阿塞拜疆省发生。震级为7.1，是伊朗规模最大的地震之一，最高烈度达到麦加利烈度IX级（剧烈）。地震发生前15小时出现强烈前震。地震学家和相关机构的报告称，伊朗西北部及土耳其东南部可能有多达3,000人遇难。

en.s: Convoy QP 11 (28 April – 7 May 1942) was an Arctic convoy of the Second World War, of merchant ships returning from the Soviet Union to Iceland. The convoy consisted of 13 merchant ships, escorted by 18 warships in relays. The convoy was attacked by German destroyers and submarines, losing one merchant ship to the destroyers. The light cruiser HMS Edinburgh was torpedoed by U-456.

zh.s: 1944年法国杯决赛于1944年5月7日在巴黎王子公园体育场举行。南锡-洛林联队以4比0击败兰斯-香槟联队，马塞尔·帕梅吉亚尼、马塞尔·波布洛姆（两球）和米歇尔·雅克各进一球。

en.s: The Battle of Kuryłówka, fought between the Polish anti-communist resistance organization, National Military Alliance (NZW) and the Soviet Union's NKVD units, took place on May 7, 1945 in the village of Kuryłówka, southeastern Poland. en.t: Tokyo Telecommunications Engineering (later renamed Sony) is founded
en.s: Sony Group Corporation is a Japanese multinational conglomerate headquartered at the Sony City building in Minato, Tokyo. The Sony Group is a highly diversified global conglomerate with businesses spanning video games, music, film and television, consumer electronics, imaging and sensing, semiconductors, financial services and others. Sony was founded in 1946 as Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo K.K. by Masaru Ibuka and Akio Morita.

zh.t: 东京通信工业（后更名为索尼）成立
zh.s: 索尼集团是一家总部位于东京港区索尼城大楼的日本跨国企业集团，业务涵盖电子游戏、音乐、电影和电视、消费电子、成像与传感器、半导体、金融服务等多个领域。索尼于1946年由井深大和盛田昭夫创立，最初名为东京通信工业株式会社。

en.s: The Hague Congress or the Congress of Europe was a conference that was held in The Hague from 7–11 May 1948 with 750 delegates participating from around Europe as well as observers from Canada and the United States. The Congress, organized by Duncan Sandys and Józef Retinger, brought together representatives from across a broad political spectrum, providing them with the opportunity to discuss ideas about the development of European political co-operation.

en.s: The Battle of Điện Biên Phủ was a defeat of the French Union forces by the Viet Minh forces in the First Indochina War. It took place between 13 March and 7 May 1954. The French began an operation to insert, and support, their soldiers at Điện Biên Phủ, deep in the autonomous Tai Federation in northwest Tonkin.

zh.s: 奠边府战役是第一次印度支那战争中的一场战役，法兰西联盟部队被越盟部队击败。战役从1954年3月13日持续至5月7日。法国军方发动行动，将士兵部署到奠边府并为其提供支援；该地位于东京西北部的泰族自治区腹地。

en.s: The 1954 Paraguayan coup d'état occurred in May 1954. It was led by Alfredo Stroessner, with the support of Epifanio Méndez Fleitas, and resulted in the overthrow of the government of Federico Chávez. The coup was the culmination of a complex series of political rivalries within the ruling Colorado Party. Approximately 25 people were killed during the putsch, which helped set the stage for the election of Stroessner as president of Paraguay later that year.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1954年巴拉圭政变于1954年5月发生。政变由阿尔弗雷多·斯特罗斯纳领导，获埃皮法尼奥·门德斯·弗莱塔斯支持，推翻费德里科·查韦斯政府。政变是执政的红党内部一系列复杂政治斗争的高潮，约有25人丧生。政变为斯特罗斯纳当年稍晚当选巴拉圭总统铺平了道路。

en.s: The 1955 FA Cup final was the 74th final of the FA Cup. It took place on 7 May 1955 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between Newcastle United and Manchester City. Newcastle won the match 3–1, thus winning the FA Cup for the third time in five years and the sixth time in all.

zh.s: 1955年英格兰足总杯决赛是第74场足总杯决赛，于1955年5月7日在温布利球场举行。纽卡斯尔联队对阵曼彻斯特城队，最终以3比1获胜。这是纽卡斯尔联五年内第三次、队史第六次夺得足总杯。

en.s: The 1960 FA Cup final was the 79th final of the world's oldest domestic football cup competition, the FA Cup. It took place on 7 May 1960 at Wembley Stadium in London. The match was contested by Blackburn Rovers and Wolverhampton Wanderers. Wolves won the game after a 3–0 victory, with a Norman Deeley double after Blackburn defender Mick McGrath had scored an own goal.

zh.s: 1960年英格兰足总杯决赛是世界上历史最悠久的国内足球杯赛——足总杯的第79场决赛，于1960年5月7日在伦敦温布利球场举行。布莱克本流浪者队对阵伍尔弗汉普顿流浪者队，后者以3比0获胜。诺曼·迪利梅开二度；比赛中，布莱克本后卫米克·麦格拉思还自摆乌龙。

en.s: The 1961 Coupe de France final was a football match, held at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on May 7, 1961, that saw UA Sedan-Torcy defeat Nîmes Olympique 3–1, thanks to goals by Maxime Fulgenzy, Claude Brény and Mohamed Salem.

zh.s: 1961年法国杯决赛于1961年5月7日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦尔奥林匹克体育场举行。色当-托尔西联盟队以3比1击败尼姆奥林匹克队，马克西姆·富尔根齐、克洛德·布雷尼和穆罕默德·萨利姆各进一球。

en.s: 1961 Emperor's Cup Final was the 41st final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at Fujieda Higashi High School Ground in Shizuoka on May 7, 1961. Furukawa Electric won the championship.

zh.s: 1961年日本天皇杯决赛是第41届天皇杯决赛，于1961年5月7日在静冈县藤枝东高中球场举行。古河电工队夺得冠军。

en.s: The Election Commission of India held indirect 3rd presidential elections of India on May 7, 1962. Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan with 553,067 votes won the presidency over his rivals Chowdhry Hari Ram who got 6,341 votes and Yamuna Prasad Trisulia who got 3,537 votes.

zh.s: 印度选举委员会于1962年5月7日举行第三次总统间接选举。萨尔维帕利·拉达克里希南以553,067票当选总统，击败对手乔杜里·哈里·拉姆（6,341票）和亚穆纳·普拉萨德·特里苏利亚（3,537票）。

en.s: The 15th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 7–23, 1962. The Palme d'Or went to the O Pagador de Promessas by Anselmo Duarte. The festival opened with Les Amants de Teruel, directed by Raymond Rouleau.

zh.s: 第15届戛纳电影节于1962年5月7日至23日举行。金棕榈奖授予安塞尔莫·杜阿尔特执导的《承诺者》。电影节开幕影片是雷蒙·鲁洛执导的《特鲁埃尔的恋人》。

en.s: The 1962 Indian vice presidential election was held in 7 May 1962 to elect the vice president of India. Zakir Husain was elected for the post. This was the first contested election for Vice Presidency in India, as the first two elections were uncontested, with Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan being the only candidate. He won against N. C. Samantsinhar by a landslide.

zh.s: 印度于1962年5月7日举行副总统选举。扎基尔·侯赛因当选。这是印度首次有竞争的副总统选举，此前两次选举都只有萨瓦帕利·拉达克里希南一名候选人，未经竞争便当选。侯赛因以悬殊票数击败N·C·萨曼特辛哈尔。

en.s: An election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 7 May 1963, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 23 were up for election. After the election Edinburgh Corporation remained under No Overall Control, composed of 33 Progressives, 31 Labour councillors, and 5 Liberal.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市政机构选举于1963年5月7日举行，与苏格兰各地的市政选举同时进行。议会69席中有23席参加改选。选后爱丁堡市政机构仍没有任何政党占据多数，席位分布为进步党33席、工党31席、自由党5席。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 7 May 1963. In the presidential election, incumbent William Tubman of the True Whig Party was the only candidate, and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1963年5月7日举行大选。总统选举中，真实辉格党现任总统威廉·塔布曼是唯一候选人，未经竞争再次当选。

en.s: The 1963 Baltimore mayoral election saw the former mayor and governor Theodore McKeldin return to office for a second non-consecutive term as mayor by defeating incumbent mayor Philip H. Goodman. To date, this is the last time a Republican won a mayoral election in Baltimore. It is also the last time a Republican managed even 30% of the city's vote.

zh.s: 1963年巴尔的摩市长选举中，前市长兼州长西奥多·麦凯尔丁击败时任市长菲利普·H·古德曼，重新当选市长。这是共和党至今最后一次在巴尔的摩市长选举中获胜，也是共和党候选人最后一次在该市获得至少30%的选票。

en.s: Pacific Air Lines Flight 773 was a Fairchild F27A Friendship airliner that crashed on May 7, 1964, near San Ramon, California, a suburb in the East Bay, east of Oakland. The crash was most likely the first instance in the United States of an airliner's pilots being shot by a passenger as part of a murder–suicide.

zh.t: 太平洋航空773号班机空难
zh.s: 太平洋航空773号班机是一架费尔柴尔德F27A“友谊”客机。1964年5月7日，它在加利福尼亚州圣拉蒙附近坠毁；圣拉蒙位于东湾、奥克兰以东。此次事故很可能是美国首宗乘客枪杀客机飞行员并随后自杀的事件。

en.s: The 1964 London local elections were held on 7 May 1964 alongside nationwide elections. They were the inaugural elections for the thirty-two London boroughs, which were created on 1 April 1965 by the London Government Act 1963. All seats were up for election, with polling stations open between 08:00 and 21:00. The result was a landslide for the Labour Party, who won twenty of the boroughs.

zh.s: 1964年伦敦地方选举于5月7日举行，与英国全国范围内的选举同时进行。这是32个伦敦自治市成立后的首次选举；这些自治市依据《1963年伦敦政府法》于1965年4月1日设立。所有席位都参加改选，投票站从上午8时开放至晚上9时。工党大胜，赢得20个自治市。

en.s: The 1964 Danish Cup final (Danish: DBUs Landspokalfinale 1964) was a men's association football match between Esbjerg fB and Odense KFUM played at Københavns Idrætspark on 7 May 1964. It was the final match to determine the winner of the 1963–64 Danish Cup, the 10th season of the Danish national-wide annual football knockout competition, the Danish Cup, open to all DBU member clubs.

zh.s: 1964年丹麦杯决赛（丹麦语：DBUs Landspokalfinale 1964）是埃斯比约足球俱乐部与欧登塞基督教青年会队之间的一场男子足球比赛，于1964年5月7日在哥本哈根体育公园举行。这场比赛决出1963—64赛季丹麦杯冠军；该项全国性年度淘汰赛向丹麦足协所有会员俱乐部开放，本赛季是其第10届。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 7 May 1964. After the election, the composition of the council was: Note that there was one Conservative Aldermanic vacancy.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1964年5月7日举行。选举后，议会席位构成为：另有一个保守党籍市议员席位空缺。

en.s: General elections were held in Rhodesia, renamed the year before from Southern Rhodesia, on 7 May 1965. The result was a victory for the ruling Rhodesian Front, which won 50 of the 65 seats in the Legislative Assembly of Rhodesia. Later in the year, the government made a unilateral declaration of independence (UDI).

zh.s: 罗得西亚于1965年5月7日举行大选。该国于前一年从南罗得西亚更名而来。执政的罗得西亚阵线获胜，在罗得西亚立法议会65席中赢得50席。同年稍晚，政府单方面宣布独立。

en.s: An Election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 7 May 1968, alongside municipal elections across Scotlands. Of the councils 68 seats, 22 were up for election. Despite receiving the most votes of any single party, the SNP won only 7 seats. Unlike in Glasgow, the Progressives and Conservatives did not run on a joint ticket. Despite that however the parties only ran competing candidates in the Gorgie-Dalry ward. Following the election Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 34 Progressives (including the Lord Provost), 21 Labour councillors, 8 SNP councillors, 3 Conservatives, 1 Liberal, and 1 independent.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市政议会选举于1968年5月7日举行，与苏格兰各地的市政选举同日进行。议会68席中有22席参加改选。苏格兰民族党得票数超过其他任何单一政党，但只赢得7席。与格拉斯哥不同，进步党和保守党没有组成联合名单；不过两党只在戈尔吉-达尔里选区派出相互竞争的候选人。选后议会由34名进步党议员（包括市长）、21名工党议员、8名苏格兰民族党议员、3名保守党议员、1名自由党议员和1名无党籍议员组成。

en.s: The 1968 Alabama Democratic presidential elector primary was held on May 7, 1968, to choose the ten nominees for presidential electors to be listed on the general election ballot under the Democratic party label in the 1968 United States presidential election in Alabama. Unlike in 1964, former Governor of Alabama George Wallace did not seek the national Democratic nomination for President, instead opting to run on a third-party ticket.

zh.t: 1968年阿拉巴马州民主党总统选举人初选
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州民主党总统选举人初选于1968年5月7日举行，目的是选出10名提名人，让他们以民主党候选人身份列入1968年美国总统选举阿拉巴马州选票，竞逐总统选举人席位。与1964年不同，阿拉巴马州前州长乔治·华莱士没有争取民主党全国总统候选人提名，而是选择以第三党候选人身份参选。

en.s: A presidential primary was held in the U.S. state of Alabama on May 7, 1968, with runoff elections in some congressional districts on June 4, to elect delegates representing Alabama to the 1968 Democratic National Convention. A substantial number of Alabama's national convention delegates were pledged to former Governor George Wallace as a favorite son candidate, despite his wishes.

zh.t: 1968年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on May 7, 1972. Democrazia Cristiana (DC) remained stable with around 38% of the votes, as it happened to the Communist Party (PCI) which obtained the same 27% of 1968. The Socialist Party (PSI) continued in its decline, reducing to less than 10%. The most important growth was that of the post-fascist Italian Social Movement, who nearly doubled its votes from 4.5 to c. 9%, after that its leader Giorgio Almirante launched the formula of the National Right, proposing his party as the sole group of the Italian right side.

zh.s: 意大利于1972年5月7日举行大选。基督教民主党得票率保持在约38%；意大利共产党也与1968年一样，获得27%的选票。社会党的得票率继续下滑，降至10%以下。增长最明显的是后法西斯主义的意大利社会运动，得票率从4.5%接近翻倍至约9%。该党领袖乔治·阿尔米兰特提出“国家右翼”路线，将该党定位为意大利右翼的唯一代表。

en.s: The 1972 WFA Cup Final was the second final of the WFA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was played under the auspices of the Women's Football Association (WFA). The final was a replay of the 1971 final, as Southampton and Lee's (formerly Stewarton Thistle) and was contested at Eton Park, the former home stadium of Burton Albion.

en.s: There were elections for the Scottish district councils on Tuesday 7 May 1974, for both the new regional and district councils, between the two United Kingdom general elections of February and October in that same year. These were the first elections held to the 53 district councils established by the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. The Labour Party did reasonably well and the Scottish National Party (SNP) did not. The councillors acted as "shadow" councils until May 1975, when the Monarchy of the United Kingdom approved by Royal Assent the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973.

zh.s: 苏格兰区议会选举于1974年5月7日（星期二）举行，新成立的大区议会和区议会都参加选举。两次英国大选分别在同年2月和10月举行，因此这次地方选举在两次大选之间进行。这是依据《1973年苏格兰地方政府法》设立的53个区议会首次举行选举。工党表现不错，苏格兰民族党则表现不佳。1975年5月英国君主批准《1973年苏格兰地方政府法》之前，当选议员以“影子议会”的身份履职。

en.t: 1974 City of Edinburgh District Council election
en.s: Elections to City of Edinburgh District Council were held on 7 May 1974, on the same day as the other Scottish local government elections. This was the first election to the district council following the implementation of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. The election used the 64 wards created by the Formation Electoral Arrangements in 1974. Each ward elected one councillor using first-past-the-post voting.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市区议会选举于1974年5月7日举行，与苏格兰其他地方政府选举同日。这是1973年《苏格兰地方政府法》实施后，该区议会举行的首次选举。选举采用1974年选区安排划定的64个选区，每个选区以简单多数制选出一名议员。

en.s: The first election to the Western Isles Islands Council was held on 7 May 1974 as part of the wider 1974 Scottish regional elections. All candidates stood as Independents, and 16 candidates were elected unopposed. Several members of political parties ran as independent candidates. This included Roderick MacLeod in Shawbost, who had contested the Western Isles constituency for the Conservatives in 1970, and Mary McCormack, election agent for Labour candidate Andrew Wilson in February 1974, both of whom were unsuccessful.

zh.s: 西部群岛议会首次选举于1974年5月7日举行，是1974年苏格兰地方选举的一部分。所有候选人均以独立人士身份参选，其中16人未经竞争当选。数名政党成员也以独立候选人身份参选，包括绍博斯特选区的罗德里克·麦克劳德（他曾于1970年代表保守党竞选西部群岛选区），以及曾于1974年2月担任工党候选人安德鲁·威尔逊竞选代理人的玛丽·麦科马克；两人均未当选。

en.s: Elections to the Shetland Islands Council were held on 7 May 1974 as part of Scottish local elections. This was the first election for the all-purpose Shetland Islands Council, as established by the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973, combining the Lerwick Town Council and the Zetland County Council. The Council operated as a shadow authority until May 1975, when it assumed full responsibilities for local government in Shetland. 11 seats were uncontested.

zh.s: 设得兰群岛议会选举于1974年5月7日举行，是苏格兰地方选举的一部分。这是根据1973年《苏格兰地方政府法》设立的综合性设得兰群岛议会首次选举，该议会合并了勒威克镇议会和泽特兰郡议会。新议会作为过渡机构运作至1975年5月，之后正式承担设得兰群岛的地方政府职责。11个席位无人竞争。

en.s: The 1974 Orkney Islands Council election, the first election to Orkney Islands Council, was held on 7 May 1974 as part of the wider 1974 Scottish regional elections. Only independent candidates contested the election and eight seats were uncontested. The newly elected Orkney Islands Council existed as a shadow authority until 1975, when it inherited sole authority for local government in Orkney from the Orkney County Council, Kirkwall Town Council and Stromness Town Council.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会首次选举于1974年5月7日举行，是1974年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。只有独立候选人参选，其中8个席位无人竞争。新选出的奥克尼群岛议会作为过渡机构运作至1975年；此后，它从奥克尼郡议会、柯克沃尔镇议会和斯特罗姆内斯镇议会手中接管了奥克尼地方政府的全部职权。

en.s: The first election to Highland Regional Council was held on 7 May 1974 as part of the wider 1974 Scottish local elections. The election saw Independents win control of 37 of the councils 47 seats.

zh.s: 高地地区议会首次选举于1974年5月7日举行，是1974年苏格兰地方选举的一部分。独立人士赢得47席中的37席，掌控议会。

en.t: 1974 Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council election
en.s: The first Dumfries and Galloway regional council election took place on 7 May 1974, along with the first district council elections in Scotland. This new system was created by the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973, which saw the making of a two-tier system of local government. The area Dumfries and Galloway regional council covered also contained 4 district councils: Annandale and Eskdale Nithsdale Merrick Stewartry Turnout was low and 12 out of the 35 wards in Dumfries and Galloway were uncontested.

zh.s: 斯特拉斯克莱德地区议会选举于1974年5月7日（星期二）举行，与苏格兰另外8个地区议会选举同日。这是1973年《苏格兰地方政府法》实施后该地区议会举行的首次选举。本次采用1974年选区安排划定的103个选区，每个选区以简单多数制选出一名议员。

en.s: The 1977 Scottish Cup Final was played on 7 May 1977 at Hampden Park in Glasgow and was the final of the 92nd Scottish Cup. Celtic and Rangers contested the match, Celtic won the match 1–0 with Andy Lynch scoring a penalty in the 20th minute after Johnstone was judged to have handled the ball on the line.

en.s: The 1978 Indian Federation Cup final was the 2nd final of the Indian Federation Cup, the top knock-out competition in India, and was contested between Kolkata giants East Bengal and Mohun Bagan on 7 May 1978 and the replay on 9 May 1978 at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Both the teams were announced as joint winners after both the matches ended 0–0 after full time.

zh.s: 1978年印度联邦杯决赛是印度最高级别淘汰赛——联邦杯的第二场决赛。加尔各答的东孟加拉队和莫亨巴根队于1978年5月7日在泰米尔纳德邦哥印拜陀的贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁体育场交手，并于5月9日重赛。两场比赛在常规时间内均以0比0结束，因此双方并列冠军。

en.s: The 1981 Humberside County Council election was held on Thursday, 7 May 1981, following boundary changes to the county's electoral divisions. The whole council of 75 members was up for election and the election resulted in the Labour Party regaining control of the council from the Conservative Party, winning 42 seats. Humberside was a created as a non-metropolitan county in England by the Local Government Act 1972, with the first elections to the county council taking place in 1973. It was abolished on 1 April 1996 and replaced by East Riding of Yorkshire, Kingston upon Hull, North East Lincolnshire and North Lincolnshire.

zh.s: 亨伯赛德郡议会选举于1981年5月7日（星期四）举行，此前郡内选区边界经过调整。议会全部75席都进行改选，工党以42席从保守党手中重新赢得议会控制权。亨伯赛德依据《1972年地方政府法》在英格兰设立为非都市郡，首次郡议会选举于1973年举行。1996年4月1日，亨伯赛德郡被撤销，辖区由东约克郡、赫尔河畔金斯顿、东北林肯郡和北林肯郡接管。

en.s: The 1981 Nottinghamshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 7 May 1981, following boundary changes to the county's electoral divisions. The whole council of eighty-eight members was up for election and the election resulted in the Labour Party regaining control from the Conservatives, winning fifty-five seats. The Conservatives won thirty-two councillors and one Residents' association councillor was elected in the Hucknall East division.

zh.s: 1981年诺丁汉郡郡议会选举于1981年5月7日（星期四）举行，此前该郡的选区边界有所调整。郡议会全部88席都进行改选，工党赢得55席，从保守党手中重新取得控制权。保守党赢得32席，另有一名居民协会候选人在哈克纳尔东选区当选。

en.s: Elections to Wiltshire County Council were held on Thursday, 7 May 1981, following boundary changes to the county's electoral divisions. The whole council of seventy-four members was up for election and the result was that the Conservatives retained their control, winning forty seats. Labour ended with twenty county councillors, the Liberals twelve, and Independents two, including one Ratepayer.

zh.s: 威尔特郡郡议会选举于1981年5月7日（星期四）举行，此前该郡的选区边界有所调整。郡议会全部74席都进行改选。保守党赢得40席，继续执政；工党获得20席，自由党12席，独立人士2席，其中一人代表纳税人团体。

en.s: There was an election to the Greater London Council held on 7 May 1981. Councillors were elected to serve until elections in May 1985. Those elections were cancelled and the term was extended until 1 April 1986. Whilst the moderate leader of the Labour GLC group Andrew McIntosh led the party into the election, and became GLC Leader.

zh.s: 大伦敦议会选举于1981年5月7日举行。当选议员原定任职至1985年5月的选举，但该次选举后来被取消，议员任期延长至1986年4月1日。工党大伦敦议会党团的温和派领袖安德鲁·麦金托什带领该党参加选举，并成为大伦敦议会领袖。

en.s: Elections to Cumbria County Council were held on 7 May 1981. This was on the same day as other UK county council elections. The council size was increased to 83 members following a boundary review. The Labour Party gained control of the council from the Conservative Party.

en.s: The 1981 Hertfordshire County Council election took place on 7 May 1981 to elect members of Hertfordshire County Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Boundary changes came into effect at this election with a new pattern of electoral divisions being used. The number of seats on the council was increased from 72 to 77.

zh.s: 1981年赫特福德郡议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。本次选举实施新的选区划分，议会席位从72席增至77席。

en.s: Local elections to Northumberland County Council, a county council in the north east of England, were held on 7 May 1981, resulting in a council with Labour members forming a majority.

zh.s: 英格兰东北部诺森伯兰郡议会于1981年5月7日举行地方选举，选后工党议员取得多数。

en.s: Elections to South Yorkshire County Council, a metropolitan county council of Yorkshire in England, were held on 7 May 1981, resulting in a council with Labour members forming a majority. This was the last election to the South Yorkshire county council, as metropolitan county councils were abolished in 1986.

zh.s: 英格兰约克郡的大都会郡议会南约克郡郡议会于1981年5月7日举行选举，选后工党取得多数。这是南约克郡郡议会最后一次选举；大都会郡议会于1986年废除。

en.s: Local elections to the West Midlands County Council, a Metropolitan County Council encompassing the West Midlands, were held on 7 May 1981, resulting in large swings to Labour, giving them control of the council. This was the last election to the West Midlands County Council, after metropolitan county councils were scrapped on 31 March 1986 under the Local Government Act 1985 by the Conservative government of Margaret Thatcher.

zh.s: 英格兰大都会郡议会西米德兰兹郡议会于1981年5月7日举行地方选举，工党大幅增加选票并取得议会控制权。这是西米德兰兹郡议会最后一次选举。玛格丽特·撒切尔领导的保守党政府依据《1985年地方政府法》，于1986年3月31日废除了大都会郡议会。

en.s: Elections were held to Lancashire County Council as part of the wider 1981 United Kingdom local elections and under new division boundaries. Any multi-member wards were abolished and each of 99 wards returned one councillor in this election. The election saw a significant Labour recovery from the previous, along with a Conservative fall, leading Labour to gain control of the council for the first time in its history.

zh.s: 兰开夏郡议会选举是1981年英国地方选举的一部分，选区边界也采用了新划分。多议席选区被取消，99个选区各选出一名议员。工党较上次选举大幅回升，保守党得票下滑，工党因此首次取得该议会控制权。

en.s: The 36th Cannes Film Festival was held on May 7–19, 1983. The Palme d'Or went to the Narayama Bushiko by Shōhei Imamura. The festival opened with The King of Comedy, directed by Martin Scorsese and closed with WarGames, directed by John Badham.

zh.s: 第36届戛纳电影节于1983年5月7日至19日举行。金棕榈奖授予今村昌平执导的《楢山节考》。电影节开幕影片是马丁·斯科塞斯执导的《喜剧之王》，闭幕影片是约翰·巴德姆执导的《战争游戏》。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Wannon on 7 May 1983. This was triggered by the resignation of Liberal Party MP and former prime minister Malcolm Fraser.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院旺农选区于1983年5月7日举行补选。自由党议员、前总理马尔科姆·弗雷泽辞职，引发这场补选。

en.s: The Third National Parliamentary Elections 1986 (Bengali: তৃতীয় জাতীয় সংসদ নির্বাচন ১৯৮৬) were held in Bangladesh on 7 May 1986. A total of 1,527 candidates contested the election. The result was a victory for the Jatiya Party, which won 153 of the 300 seats. Voter turnout was 61.1%. Bangladesh Nationalist Party, the winner of the previous elections, boycotted the election.

zh.s: 孟加拉国第三次国民议会选举于1986年5月7日举行，共有1,527名候选人参选。民族党赢得300席中的153席，取得胜利。投票率为61.1%。上届选举的获胜党孟加拉国民族主义党抵制了本次选举。

en.s: The 1986 European Cup final was a football match played at the Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium, Seville, Spain, on 7 May 1986 to determine the champions of that season's European Cup. Steaua București of Romania defeated Barcelona of Spain in a shootout, with keeper Helmut Duckadam saving all 4 shots. It was the first European Cup final to finish goalless and remains Steaua's only European Cup triumph, and the first of only two won by an Eastern European club.

zh.s: 1986年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1986年5月7日在西班牙塞维利亚的拉蒙·桑切斯·皮斯胡安球场举行，决出当季冠军杯冠军。罗马尼亚布加勒斯特星队在点球大战中击败西班牙巴塞罗那队，门将赫尔穆特·杜克达姆扑出全部4个点球。这是首场常规时间以0比0结束的欧洲冠军杯决赛，也是布加勒斯特星队唯一一次夺得冠军杯冠军；东欧俱乐部此前只赢过一次，此后也只再赢过一次。

en.s: The 40th Cannes Film Festival was held on 7–19 May 1987. The Palme d'Or went to the Sous le soleil de Satan by Maurice Pialat. The festival opened with Un homme amoureux, directed by Diane Kurys and closed with Aria, directed by Robert Altman, Bruce Beresford, Bill Bryden, Jean-Luc Godard, Derek Jarman, Franc Roddam, Nicolas Roeg, Ken Russell, Charles Sturridge and Julien Temple.

zh.s: 第40届戛纳电影节于1987年5月7日至19日举行。金棕榈奖授予莫里斯·皮亚拉执导的《在撒旦的阳光下》。电影节开幕影片是黛安·居里执导的《一个恋爱中的男人》，闭幕影片是《咏叹调》，由罗伯特·奥特曼、布鲁斯·贝雷斯福德、比尔·布莱登、让-吕克·戈达尔、德里克·贾曼、弗朗克·罗丹、尼古拉斯·罗伊格、肯·罗素、查尔斯·斯特里奇和朱利安·邓波执导。

en.s: Elections to the Adur District Council were held on 7 May 1987, with one third of the council up for election. There were additional vacancies in the Churchill and Widewater wards and no elections for the two-member Marine ward. Overall turnout climbed to 48.3%. The election resulted in the Alliance retaining control of the council.

zh.s: 阿杜尔区议会选举于1987年5月7日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选。丘吉尔和怀德沃特选区另有空缺需要改选，双议席的滨海选区则没有选举。总体投票率升至48.3%。联盟党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1987 Plymouth City Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained control of the council, which it had held since its creation in 1973.

zh.s: 1987年普利茅斯市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德文郡普利茅斯市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。自1973年议会成立以来一直掌控议会的保守党继续执政。

en.s: The 1987 Basildon District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party lost control of the council, which it had held since 1982; the council fell under no overall control.

en.s: The 1987 East Northamptonshire District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of East Northamptonshire District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council which it had held since the council's creation in 1973.

zh.t: 1987年东北安普敦郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1987年东安普敦郡区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡东安普敦郡区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党继续掌控议会；该党自1973年议会成立以来一直执政。

en.s: The 1987 Cambridge City Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 1987年剑桥市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会议员，日期与英格兰其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Corby District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Corby District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council, which it had held since 1979.

zh.s: 1987年科比区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡科比区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。自1979年以来一直掌控议会的工党继续执政。

en.s: The 1987 Bath City Council election was held on Thursday 7 May 1987 to elect councillors to Bath City Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. One third of seats were up for election. Two seats were contested in Walcot due to an extra vacancy occurring.

zh.s: 1987年巴斯市议会选举于5月7日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰巴斯市议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选。沃尔科特选区因另有一个空缺，需要选出两名议员。

en.s: The 1987 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 7 May 1987, to elect all 40 members in 19 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England, having been renamed from Bracknell District Council. The election was held on the same day as other local elections as part of the 1987 United Kingdom local elections. The Conservative Party repeated its feat of 1983 by winning all 40 seats.

zh.t: 1987年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1987年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰布拉克内尔森林自治市议会19个选区的全部40名议员。当时该市议会刚由布拉克内尔区议会更名。本次选举是1987年英国地方选举的一部分，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党重现1983年的成绩，赢得全部40席。

en.s: Elections to Erewash Borough Council were held on 7 May 1987 as part of nationwide local elections.

zh.t: 1987年埃里沃什自治市议会选举
zh.s: 埃里沃什自治市议会选举于1987年5月7日举行，是英国全国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 1987 Exeter City Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年威勒尔自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. 19 members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex were elected. The council remained under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 1987年埃平森林区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会19名议员。保守党继续以多数掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 7 May 1987, with one third of the council up for election. Prior to the election, the defending councillor in Ardsley had won the seat for Labour in an uncontested by-election and subsequently defected to Independent Labour. The election resulted in Labour retaining control of the council.

zh.t: 1987年巴恩斯利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴恩斯利自治市议会选举于1987年5月7日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选。选举前，阿兹利选区的在任议员曾在一场无人竞争的补选中代表工党赢得席位，随后转为独立工党议员。本次选举后，工党继续掌控议会。

en.t: 1987 King's Lynn and West Norfolk Borough Council election
en.s: The 1987 King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1987年金斯林-西诺福克自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1987年金斯林和西诺福克自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡金斯林和西诺福克自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 North Norfolk District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of North Norfolk District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年北诺福克区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡北诺福克区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Braintree District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年布伦特里区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰布伦特里区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Rochford District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Rochford District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年罗奇福德区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡罗奇福德区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Brighton Borough Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Brighton Borough Council in East Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年布莱顿自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰东萨塞克斯郡布莱顿自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Breckland District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Breckland District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年布雷克兰区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡布雷克兰区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Reading Borough Council election was held on 7 May 1987, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales. One third of Reading Borough Council's 45 seats were up for election. Before the election, the council was under no overall control with Labour running a minority administration, being one seat short of an overall majority.

zh.s: 1987年雷丁自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同时进行。雷丁自治市议会45席中有三分之一参加改选。选举前，没有任何政党占据议会多数；工党组建少数派政府，距离多数席位还差1席。

en.s: The 1987 Southend-on-Sea Borough Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1987年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1987年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 7 May 1987. It was the first time since 1983 that the Conservatives had enjoyed the largest share of the vote in local council elections. Soon after the elections, Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher called a general election which resulted in a second successive Conservative landslide, although Labour managed to cut the government's overall majority, while the Alliance endured another disappointing performance and was soon disbanded as the SDP and Liberals agreed on a merger the following year.

zh.s: 1987年英国地方选举于1987年5月7日（星期四）举行。这是自1983年以来，保守党首次在地方议会选举中获得最高得票比例。选举结束后不久，首相玛格丽特·撒切尔宣布举行大选，保守党随后连续第二次大胜。工党设法缩小了保守党的议会多数优势。联盟党再次表现不佳，不久后便解散；社会民主党和自由党同意于次年合并。

en.s: The 1987 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡沃辛自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 West Dorset District Council election was held on Thursday 7 May 1987 to elect councillors to West Dorset District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. The entire council was up for election as West Dorset returned to whole councils elections, after previously having been elected in thirds.

zh.s: 西多塞特区议会选举于1987年5月7日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰西多塞特区议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。西多塞特恢复整届议会同时改选，此前曾采用分批改选。

en.s: The 1987 Bournemouth Borough Council election was held on 7 May 1987 to elect members to Bournemouth Borough Council in Dorset, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives maintained control of the council.

zh.t: 1987年伯恩茅斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1987年伯恩茅斯自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰多塞特郡伯恩茅斯自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1987 Welwyn Hatfield District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. A third of the seats were up for contest; one from each ward, plus an additional seat in Welwyn South to fill a casual vacancy.

zh.t: 1987年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举
zh.s: 1987年韦林哈特菲尔德区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰韦林哈特菲尔德区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。议会三分之一席位参加改选，每个选区选出一人；韦林南区还需填补一个临时空缺。

en.s: The 1987 Horsham District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives retained control of the council with 33 seats, a majority of 12. The SDP–Liberal Alliance won 6 seats and Independents won 4.

zh.s: 1987年霍舍姆区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党赢得33席，继续掌控议会，多数席位为12席。社会民主党-自由党联盟赢得6席，独立人士赢得4席。

en.s: The 1987 Thurrock Borough Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Thurrock Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.s: 1987年瑟罗克自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡瑟罗克自治市议会议员，日期与英格兰其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Chester City Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1987年切斯特市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰柴郡切斯特市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 1987 Wansdyke Council election was held on Thursday 7 May 1987 to elect councillors to Wansdyke District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. The 1987 election saw the Conservatives win the largest number of seats and maintain majority control.

zh.s: 旺斯代克区议会选举于1987年5月7日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰旺斯代克区议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。保守党赢得最多席位，并继续以多数掌控议会。

en.s: The 1987 Harlow District Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections held across the United Kingdom. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1987年哈洛区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员，日期与英国各地其他地方选举相同。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1987 Chelmsford City Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Chelmsford Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was contested on new ward boundaries, decreasing the number of seats by 4 to 56.

zh.t: 1987年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1987年切姆斯福德市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡切姆斯福德自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。本次选举采用新的选区边界，席位减少4席至56席。

en.s: The 1987 Derby City Council election took place on 7 May 1987 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. Local elections were held in the United Kingdom in 1987. This was on the same day as other local elections. 15 of the council's 44 seats were up for election. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1987年德比市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员，是英国1987年地方选举的一部分，日期与其他地方选举相同。议会44席中有15席参加改选。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1987 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 7 May 1987. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election: the seats of which were last contested in 1983. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 1987年林肯市议会选举于5月7日举行，日期与其他地方选举相同。议会三分之一席位参加改选，这些席位上次于1983年改选。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1987 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 7 May 1987, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales. There were 17 out of 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council up for election, being the usual third of the council. The Conservatives retained their narrow majority on the council.

zh.t: 1987年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1987年北赫特福德郡区议会选举于5月7日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同日。议会50席中有17席参加改选，约占通常改选的三分之一。保守党以微弱多数继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Mid Bedfordshire District Council were held on 7 May 1987. All 53 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 1987年中贝德福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 中贝德福德郡区议会选举于1987年5月7日举行。议会全部53席都进行改选。

en.s: Panama held a general election on 7 May 1989, with the goal of electing both a new President of the Republic and a new Legislative Assembly. The two primary candidates in the presidential race were Guillermo Endara, who headed Democratic Alliance of Civic Opposition (ADOC), a coalition opposed to military ruler Manuel Noriega, and Carlos Duque, who headed the pro-Noriega Democratic Revolutionary Party (PRD). However, the election was annulled before voting was completed by Noriega's government, and Endara and his running mate Guillermo Ford were attacked in front of foreign media by Noriega supporters, events that contributed to the US invasion of Panama in December of that year.

zh.s: 巴拿马于1989年5月7日举行大选，选出新一任总统和新一届立法议会。总统选举的两名主要候选人是民主反对派联盟候选人吉列尔莫·恩达拉，以及亲诺列加的民主革命党候选人卡洛斯·杜克。恩达拉领导的联盟反对军事统治者曼努埃尔·诺列加。投票尚未结束，诺列加政府便宣布选举无效。此后，恩达拉和竞选搭档吉列尔莫·福特在外国媒体面前遭诺列加支持者袭击。这些事件促成美国于当年12月入侵巴拿马。

en.s: General elections were held in Bolivia on 7 May 1989. As no candidate for the presidency received over 50% of the vote, the National Congress was required to elect a President on 6 August. Although the Revolutionary Nationalist Movement had received the most votes, its candidate for President Gonzalo Sánchez de Lozada was defeated by Jaime Paz Zamora of the Revolutionary Left Movement (MIR) in the Congressional vote, despite the MIR only finishing third in the public vote.

zh.s: 玻利维亚于1989年5月7日举行大选。由于没有总统候选人得票超过50%，国民议会须于8月6日选出总统。革命民族主义运动获得最多普选票，但其总统候选人贡萨洛·桑切斯·德洛萨达在国会投票中败给革命左翼运动（MIR）的海梅·帕斯·萨莫拉；MIR在普选中仅排名第三。

en.s: WrestleWar '89: Music City Showdown was the first WrestleWar professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW) under the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA) banner. It took place on May 7, 1989 from the Nashville Municipal Auditorium in Nashville, Tennessee. The main event was a tag team match between Eddie Gilbert and Rick Steiner and The Varsity Club (Kevin Sullivan and Dan Spivey) for the NWA United States Tag Team Championship.

zh.t: 摔角大战89：音乐之城对决
zh.s: “摔角大战89：音乐之城对决”是世界冠军摔角（WCW）以国家摔角联盟（NWA）名义举办的首场“摔角大战”职业摔角付费赛事。赛事于1989年5月7日在田纳西州纳什维尔市政礼堂举行。主赛是一场双打赛，由埃迪·吉尔伯特和里克·斯泰纳对阵“校队俱乐部”的凯文·沙利文和丹·斯皮维，争夺NWA美国双打冠军。

en.s: The Italian regional elections of 1990 were held on 6 and 7 May. The fifteen ordinary regions, created in 1970, elected their fifth assemblies.

zh.s: 意大利于1990年5月6日至7日举行大区选举。15个于1970年设立的普通大区选出了第五届大区议会。

en.s: The Bright Sparklers Fireworks fire occurred in Sungai Buloh, Selangor, Malaysia on 7 May 1991. The Bright Sparklers Fireworks Factory in Sungai Buloh, Selangor caught fire and caused a huge explosion. Twenty six people were killed and over a hundred people were injured in the disaster. The explosion was strong enough to rip the roofs of some local houses, and ended up damaging over 200 residential properties.

zh.s: Bright Sparklers烟花厂火灾于1991年5月7日在马来西亚雪兰莪州双溪毛糯发生。该厂起火并引发大爆炸，造成26人死亡、100多人受伤。爆炸威力巨大，震塌了附近一些房屋的屋顶，并损坏200多处住宅。

en.s: The 1991 Las Vegas mayoral election took place on May 7, 1991 to elect the mayor of Las Vegas, Nevada. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. It saw the election of Jan Laverty Jones. With Jones winning a majority in the initial round of the election, no runoff was needed.

zh.s: 1991年拉斯维加斯市长选举于5月7日举行，选出内华达州拉斯维加斯市长。选举与其他地方选举同时举行，名义上不设党派。简·拉弗蒂·琼斯当选。她在首轮投票中获得多数票，因此无需举行决选。

en.s: The 1992 Bristol City Council election took place on 7 May 1992 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of seats were up for election. Two seats were contested in Hartcliffe due to an extra vacancy occurring. The elections were held just weeks after John Major's unexpected 1992 General election victory, and mirroring that result there was a strong swing from Labour to Conservative.

zh.s: 1992年布里斯托市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰布里斯托市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。议会三分之一席位参加改选。因哈特克利夫选区出现额外空缺，该区有两个席位进行选举。投票距约翰·梅杰意外赢得1992年英国大选仅数周，选举结果也与大选相似，选票明显从工党转向保守党。

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council were held on 7 May 1992. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于1992年5月7日举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选。

en.s: Elections to Trafford Council were held on 7 May 1992. One-third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1996. The Conservative party retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1992年特拉福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 特拉福德议会选举于1992年5月7日举行。议会三分之一席位参加改选，当选议员任期四年，至1996年届满。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 45th Cannes Film Festival was held on 7–18 May 1992. The Palme d'Or went to the Den goda viljan by Bille August. The festival opened with Basic Instinct, directed by Paul Verhoeven and closed with Far and Away, directed by Ron Howard.

zh.s: 第45届戛纳电影节于1992年5月7日至18日举行。金棕榈奖授予比勒·奥古斯特执导的《善意的背叛》。电影节开幕影片是保罗·范霍文执导的《本能》，闭幕影片是朗·霍华德执导的《远离家园》。

en.s: The 1992 Reading Borough Council election was held on 7 May 1992, at the same time as other local elections across England and Scotland, and a month after the general election. One third of Reading Borough Council's 45 seats were up for election.

zh.s: 1992年雷丁自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，与英格兰和苏格兰其他地方选举同日进行，距大选一个月。雷丁自治市议会45席中有三分之一参加改选。

en.s: The 1992 Basildon District Council election took place on 7 May 1992 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1988. The Conservative Party won every seat up for election, and gained control of the council for the first time, which had previously been under no overall control.

zh.s: 1992年巴西尔登区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。议会三分之一席位参加改选，这些席位上次于1988年改选。保守党赢得全部改选席位，首次取得议会控制权；此前没有任何政党占据多数。

en.s: Local elections were held in Scotland on 7 May 1992, to elect members to all 53 district councils. It was the last local election held under the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973, which had established the two-tier system of regions and districts. Regional and district councils were abolished in 1996, and replaced with 29 new mainland unitary authorities under the terms of the Local Government etc.

zh.s: 1992 年 5 月 7 日，苏格兰举行地方选举，选出全部 53 个区议会的议员。这是依据《1973 年地方政府（苏格兰）法》举行的最后一次地方选举；该法确立了地区与区两级政府。1996 年，地区议会和区议会被撤销，并依《地方政府等法》由苏格兰大陆地区的 29 个新单一管理区取代。

en.s: The 1992 Derby City Council election took place on 7 May 1992 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. Local elections were held in the United Kingdom in 1992. This was on the same day as other local elections. 14 of the council's 44 seats were up for election. No seats changed hands and the council remained under no overall control, with the Conservatives and Labour holding exactly half the seats each.

zh.s: 1992年德比市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员，是英国1992年地方选举的一部分，日期与其他地方选举相同。议会44席中有14席参加改选，没有席位易手。选后仍没有任何政党占据多数，保守党和工党各占一半席位。

en.s: The 1992 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 7 May 1992, one month after the 1992 general election which returned the governing Conservative Party for a fourth consecutive term in office. The Conservatives won back some ground that they had lost the previous year. The Conservative Party gained 303 seats, bringing their number of councillors to 8,288.

en.s: The 1992 Bath City Council election was held on Thursday 7 May 1992 to elect councillors to Bath City Council in England. Two seats were contested in Kingsmead due to an extra vacancy occurring.

zh.s: 1992年巴斯市议会选举于5月7日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰巴斯市议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选。金斯米德选区因另有一个空缺，需要选出两名议员。

en.s: Elections to the Caithness District Council took place on 7 May 1992, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. Voter turnout in the contested wards was 57.8%.

en.s: Elections to the Sutherland District Council took place on 7 May 1992, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. en.s: STS-49 was NASA's maiden flight of the Space Shuttle Endeavour, which launched on May 7, 1992. The primary goal of its nine-day mission was to retrieve an Intelsat VI satellite, Intelsat 603, which failed to leave Low Earth orbit two years before, attach it to a new upper stage, and relaunch it to its intended geosynchronous orbit.

zh.s: STS-49是NASA“奋进号”航天飞机的首次飞行任务，于1992年5月7日发射升空。为期九天的任务主要目标是回收两年前未能脱离近地轨道的国际通信卫星603号，将其接上新的上面级火箭，再送入预定的地球同步轨道。

en.t: 1992 City of Edinburgh District Council election
en.s: Elections to the City of Edinburgh District Council took place in May 1992, alongside elections to the councils of Scotland's various other districts. Labour, which had won control of the Council for the first time ever in the 1984 election, lost overall control but managed to remain the largest party on the council despite losing the popular vote amid a swing to the Conservatives in the city.

en.s: The 1992 Ipswich Borough Council election was an election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the arrangement, whereby a third of the councillors were to stand for election, each time. It took place as part of the 1992 United Kingdom local elections. There were 16 wards each returning one councillor. The Labour Party retained control of the Council.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Djibouti on 7 May 1993. They followed the constitutional changes approved in a referendum the previous year, which re-introduced multi-party democracy, and were the first presidential elections to feature more than one candidate. Nevertheless, incumbent President Hassan Gouled Aptidon of the People's Rally for Progress won, taking 60.7% of the vote, based on a 51.25 turnout.

zh.s: 吉布提于1993年5月7日举行总统选举。此前一年通过的宪法修正案恢复了多党民主；这是该国首次有多名候选人参加总统选举。尽管如此，执政的进步人民联盟候选人、现任总统哈桑·古莱德·阿普蒂敦仍以60.7%的得票率胜出，投票率为51.25%。

en.s: An indirect presidential election was held in the Parliament of Sri Lanka on 7 May 1993, following the assassination of president Ranasinghe Premadasa by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam in Colombo. The president of Sri Lanka was elected by the Parliament of Sri Lanka in a secret ballot to decide who would complete the remainder of Premadasa's term.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡议会于1993年5月7日举行间接总统选举。此前，总统拉纳辛哈·普雷马达萨在科伦坡遭泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织暗杀。议会通过秘密投票选出总统，接替普雷马达萨完成剩余任期。

en.s: The 1993 Norfolk County Council election took place on 7 May 1993 to elect members of Norfolk County Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 1993年诺福克郡议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: Sri Lankabhimanya Dingiri Banda Wijetunga (Sinhala: ඩිංගිරි බණ්ඩා විජේතුංග; Tamil: டிங்கிரி பண்ட விஜேதுங்க; 15 February 1916 – 21 September 2008) was a Sri Lankan politician who served as the fourth president of Sri Lanka from 7 May 1993 to 12 November 1994, Prime Minister of Sri Lanka from 3 March 1989 to 7 May 1993, and Governor of North Western Province from 1988 to 1989.

zh.t: D. B. 维杰通加就任总统
zh.s: 丁吉里·班达·维杰通加（僧伽罗语：ඩිංගිරි බණ්ඩා විජේතුංග；泰米尔语：டிங்கிரி பண்ட விஜேதுங்க；1916年2月15日—2008年9月21日）是斯里兰卡政治人物，曾于1993年5月7日至1994年11月12日担任斯里兰卡第四任总统，1989年3月3日至1993年5月7日担任总理，并于1988年至1989年出任西北省省长。

en.s: Presidential elections took place in France on 23 April and 7 May 1995, to elect the fifth president of the Fifth Republic. The Socialist incumbent president, François Mitterrand, who had been in office since 1981, did not stand for a third term. He was 78, had terminal cancer, and his party had lost the 1993 legislative election in a landslide defeat. Since then, he had been "cohabiting" with a right-wing cabinet led by Prime Minister Edouard Balladur, a member of the neo-Gaullist RPR party.

zh.s: 法国总统选举于1995年4月23日和5月7日举行，选出第五共和国第五任总统。社会党现任总统弗朗索瓦·密特朗自1981年起执政，没有竞选第三个任期。他当时78岁，患有晚期癌症；社会党此前在1993年立法选举中惨败。此后，他与由新戴高乐主义政党保卫共和联盟成员、总理爱德华·巴拉迪尔领导的右翼内阁共同执政。

en.s: The 1995 National Soccer League Grand Final was the championship match of the 1994–95 National Soccer League season and was played between Adelaide City and Melbourne Knights at Hindmarsh Stadium on 7 May 1995.

zh.s: 1995年全国足球联赛总决赛决出1994—95赛季冠军，由阿德莱德城队对阵墨尔本骑士队。比赛于1995年5月7日在欣德马什体育场举行。

en.s: General elections were held in India on 27 April, 2 May and 7 May 1996 to elect the members of the eleventh Lok Sabha. The elections resulted in a hung parliament with no single party having a majority. The Bharatiya Janata Party, which had won the most seats despite finishing second in the popular vote, formed a short-lived government under Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

zh.s: 印度于1996年4月27日、5月2日和5月7日举行大选，选出第十一届人民院议员。选后议会陷入僵局，没有任何政党取得多数席位。印度人民党虽然获得最多席位，但普选票排名第二，仍组建了由阿塔尔·比哈里·瓦杰帕伊担任总理的短命政府。

en.s: 1996 Indian general election was held in Maharashtra on 27 April, 2 May, and 7 May 1996. Maharashtra returns 48 MPs to the Lok Sabha. The National Democratic Alliance consisting of BJP and Shiv Sena won 33 seats, while the Congress won 15 seats.

zh.t: 1996年印度大选马哈拉施特拉邦选区
zh.s: 印度1996年大选在马哈拉施特拉邦的投票于1996年4月27日、5月2日和5月7日举行。马哈拉施特拉邦向人民院选出48名议员。由印度人民党和湿婆军组成的全国民主联盟赢得33席，国大党赢得15席。

en.s: The 50th Cannes Film Festival was held on 7–18 May 1997. The Palme d'Or was jointly awarded to Ta'm e guilass by Abbas Kiarostami and Unagi by Shohei Imamura. The festival opened with The Fifth Element, directed by Luc Besson, and closed with Absolute Power, directed by Clint Eastwood.

zh.s: 第50届戛纳电影节于1997年5月7日至18日举行。金棕榈奖由阿巴斯·基亚罗斯塔米执导的《樱桃的滋味》和今村昌平执导的《鳗鱼》共同获得。电影节开幕影片是吕克·贝松执导的《第五元素》，闭幕影片是克林特·伊斯特伍德执导的《绝对权力》。

en.s: The 1997 Peterborough City Council election took place on 7 May 1997 to elect members of Peterborough City Council in England. This was on the same day as the 1997 general election and other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new ward boundaries and the number of seats increased by 8. Labour lost their majority on the council, which they had narrowly gained at the 1996 election.

zh.s: 1997年彼得伯勒市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰彼得伯勒市议会议员，与1997年英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位在新的选区边界下改选，席位增加8席。工党在1996年选举中以微弱优势取得多数，本次失去多数地位。

en.s: The 1998 Hounslow Council election took place on 7 May 1998 to elect members of Hounslow London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council. The election saw Phil Andrews become the first member of Isleworth Community Group elected to the council after defeating a Labour candidate by two votes. However both the Labour and Conservative parties said they would not work with him due to his past membership of the National Front.

zh.t: 1998年豪恩斯洛伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1998年豪恩斯洛议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰伦敦豪恩斯洛伦敦自治市议会议员。议会全部席位都进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。菲尔·安德鲁斯以两票优势击败工党候选人，当选议员，成为首位进入议会的艾尔沃斯社区团体成员。不过，工党和保守党都表示，不会与他合作，原因是他过去曾是英国国家阵线成员。

en.s: The 1998 Greenwich Council election took place on 7 May 1998 to elect members of Greenwich Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council. The election saw a number of independent candidates contest seats and the election saw candidates standing as Greens against the Millennium Dome, Conservatives Against Town Hall Corruption, Populist Keep Our Pound and the Corrective Party. However the Labour party was always seen as highly likely to remain in control of the council.

en.s: Elections to Croydon Council in London, England were held on 7 May 1998. The whole council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council. For the first time in a local election two polling stations were situated in supermarkets. Before the election the council had been seen as a top target for the Conservatives who only needed a small swing of 2 percent to take control. The Labour party had taken control of the council for the first time in the council's history in the previous election in 1994.

zh.t: 1998年克罗伊登伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 英格兰伦敦克罗伊登议会选举于1998年5月7日举行。议会全部席位都进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。这是克罗伊登首次在地方选举中设立两个超市投票站。选举前，保守党将该议会列为重要目标，只需得票率提高2个百分点便可取得控制权。工党在1994年上次选举中首次赢得该议会控制权。

en.t: Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election, 1998
en.s: The 1998 Barking and Dagenham Council election took place on 7 May 1998 to elect members of Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council. The election saw the Conservative party only put up five candidates in the election and they failed to win any seats on the council. The Labour leader of the council, George Brooker, stood down at the election after 51 years. He opposed the Greater London Authority referendum that took place at the same time as the election, however Barking and Dagenham saw 73.49% vote in favour and 26.51% against.

zh.t: 1998年巴金和达格纳姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1998年巴金和达格纳姆议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰伦敦巴金和达格纳姆伦敦自治市议会议员。议会全部席位都进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。保守党只派出5名候选人，没有赢得任何席位。工党议会领袖乔治·布鲁克在选举时卸任，结束了长达51年的任期。他反对同日举行的设立大伦敦政府公投；但在巴金和达格纳姆，73.49%的选民投赞成票，26.51%投反对票。

en.s: Local elections took place in many parts of England on 7 May 1998. All London borough council seats were elected as well a third of the seats on each of the Metropolitan Boroughs. Some unitary authorities and District councils also had elections. There were no local elections in Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland. These elections took place on the same day as the referendum on establishing the Greater London Authority. The governing Labour Party, contesting its first national elections since returning to government 12 months previously, enjoyed great success, now having control of 94 councils, with the second placed Liberal Democrats now controlling 14 and the opposition Conservatives (now led by William Hague) a mere eight.

zh.s: 英格兰多个地区于1998年5月7日举行地方选举。伦敦所有自治市议会席位都进行改选，都市自治市议会则各改选三分之一席位；一些单一层级地方政府和区议会也举行选举。苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰没有举行地方选举。选举与设立大伦敦政府公投同日举行。工党在重返执政12个月后首次参加全国性选举，表现出色，掌控的议会增至94个；自由民主党掌控14个，反对党保守党（当时由威廉·黑格领导）只掌控8个。

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 7 May 1998. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2002. A vacancy each in Ardwick and Harpurhey were also being contested. There were two Labour candidates for Barlow Moor ward, the result of de-selected Labour Councillor Arthur Maloney securing an official Labour Party nomination before he was replaced by a new candidate. The Independent Labour candidates stood as Labour Peace 2000. Overall turnout was 20.5%, with Labour retaining control of the council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特议会选举于1998年5月7日（星期四）举行，议会三分之一席位参加改选，胜选者任期四年，到2002年届满。阿德威克和哈珀希两个选区各有一个空缺也参加选举。巴洛摩尔选区有两名工党候选人，这是因为被取消提名的工党议员亚瑟·马洛尼在被替换前，已取得工党正式提名。独立工党候选人以“工党和平2000”名义参选。投票率为20.5%，工党继续掌控议会。
