en.s: The 1998 Derby City Council election took place on 7 May 1998 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour party kept overall control of the council. One of the two Labour councillors defeated in the election was Milton Crosdale, the father of Imaani, who was taking part in the Eurovision Song Contest for the United Kingdom two days after the election. Crosdale had been defending a three-vote majority in Blagreaves ward.

zh.s: 1998年德比市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员。议会三分之一席位进行改选，工党继续掌控议会。落选的两名工党议员之一是米尔顿·克罗斯代尔，他是伊马尼的父亲。两天后，伊马尼代表英国参加欧洲歌唱大赛。克罗斯代尔此前在布拉格里夫斯选区仅以3票多数守住席位。

en.t: Mercedes-Benz buys Chrysler for US$40 billion and forms DaimlerChrysler in the largest industrial merger in history
en.s: Mercedes-Benz (German pronunciation: [mɛʁˌtseːdəs ˈbɛnts, -dɛs -] ), commonly referred to simply as Mercedes and occasionally as Benz, is a German luxury automotive brand that was founded in 1926. Mercedes-Benz AG (a subsidiary of the Mercedes-Benz Group, established in 2019) is based in Stuttgart, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. Mercedes-Benz AG manufactures luxury vehicles and light commercial vehicles, all branded under the Mercedes-Benz name.

zh.s: 梅赛德斯-奔驰（德语发音：[mɛʁˌtseːdəs ˈbɛnts, -dɛs -]），通常简称梅赛德斯，偶尔也称奔驰，是一家创立于 1926 年的德国豪华汽车品牌。梅赛德斯-奔驰股份公司是 2019 年成立的梅赛德斯-奔驰集团旗下子公司，总部位于德国巴登-符腾堡州斯图加特，生产以梅赛德斯-奔驰为品牌的豪华汽车和轻型商用车。

en.t: United States bombing of the Chinese embassy in Belgrade
en.s: On May 7, 1999, during the NATO bombing of Yugoslavia (Operation Allied Force), five US JDAM guided bombs hit the People's Republic of China embassy in the Belgrade district of New Belgrade, killing three Chinese reporters and outraging the Chinese public. According to the U.S. government, the intention had been to bomb the nearby Yugoslav Federal Directorate for Supply and Procurement. President Bill Clinton later apologized for the bombing, stating it was accidental. Central Intelligence Agency director George Tenet testified before a congressional committee that the bombing was the only one in the campaign organized and directed by his agency, and that the CIA had identified the wrong coordinates for a Yugoslav military target on the same street.

zh.t: 美国轰炸中国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆
zh.s: 1999年5月7日，北约轰炸南斯拉夫（盟军行动）期间，美国5枚联合直接攻击弹药制导炸弹击中位于贝尔格莱德新贝尔格莱德区的中华人民共和国大使馆，造成3名中国记者死亡，并激起中国民众的愤怒。美国政府称，原本打算轰炸附近的南斯拉夫联邦供应与采购局。总统比尔·克林顿后来就此次轰炸道歉，称这是误炸。中央情报局局长乔治·特尼特向国会委员会作证称，这次轰炸是该行动中唯一一次由中情局组织和指挥的空袭，中情局为同一条街上的南斯拉夫军事目标标错了坐标。

en.s: UFC 20: Battle for the Gold was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on May 7, 1999 at the Boutwell Auditorium in Birmingham, Alabama. The event was seen live on pay per view in the United States, and later released on home video.

zh.s: UFC 20：争夺金牌是一场综合格斗赛事，由终极格斗冠军赛于1999年5月7日在美国阿拉巴马州伯明翰市的博特韦尔礼堂举办。赛事在美国通过付费电视直播，之后发行了家庭录像。

en.s: Elections were held in Zagreb on 7 May 2000 for members of the Zagreb Assembly. The elections were called after the Croatian Democratic Union (HDZ) lost the majority in the Assembly, and the Croatian Government dismissed it and appointed an acting mayor. In a record low turnout, the Zagreb Alternative coalition, led by the Social Democratic Party (SDP) and the Croatian Social Liberal Party (HSLS), won a majority of seats in the Assembly.

zh.s: 萨格勒布于2000年5月7日举行选举，选出萨格勒布议会议员。此前，克罗地亚民主联盟失去议会多数，克罗地亚政府随即解散议会并任命代理市长。在创纪录的低投票率下，由社会民主党和克罗地亚社会自由党领导的萨格勒布替代联盟赢得议会多数席位。

loc: 美国密苏里州堪萨斯城

en.s: The 2000 Slamboree was the eighth and final Slamboree professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by World Championship Wrestling (WCW). It took place on May 7, 2000 at Kemper Arena in Kansas City, Missouri. Ten matches were contested at the event. In the main event, Jeff Jarrett defeated David Arquette and Diamond Dallas Page in a Triple Cage match to win the WCW World Heavyweight Championship.

zh.s: 2000年摔角狂热大赛是世界冠军摔角（WCW）举办的第八场、也是最后一场同名职业摔角付费赛事。比赛于2000年5月7日在密苏里州堪萨斯城的肯珀体育馆举行，共进行了10场比赛。主赛是三层铁笼赛，杰夫·贾雷特击败戴维·阿奎特和钻石达拉斯·佩奇，赢得WCW世界重量级冠军。

en.s: The 2000 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade de France, Saint-Denis on 7 May 2000 that saw FC Nantes Atlantique defeat the surprising amateur team of Calais RUFC from CFA 2–1 thanks to two goals by Antoine Sibierski.

zh.s: 2000年法国杯决赛于2000年5月7日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。南特大西洋队以2比1击败来自法国第五级别业余联赛的卡莱足球联合会队，安托万·西别尔斯基梅开二度。

en.s: The 2000 Welsh Cup final saw Bangor City win the Welsh Cup after beating Cwmbran Town 1–0 at Racecourse Ground in the 113th Welsh Cup Final.

zh.s: 2000年威尔士杯决赛中，班戈城队以1比0击败坎布兰镇队，在第113届威尔士杯中夺冠。

en.t: Vladimir Putin is inaugurated as president of Russia
en.s: Vladimir Vladimirovich Putin (born 7 October 1952) is a Russian politician and former intelligence officer who has served as President of Russia since 2012, having previously served from 2000 to 2008. Putin also served as Prime Minister of Russia from 1999 to 2000 and again from 2008 to 2012. He has been described as the de facto leader of Russia since 1999.

zh.t: 弗拉基米尔·普京宣誓就任俄罗斯总统
zh.s: 弗拉基米尔·弗拉基米罗维奇·普京（生于 1952 年 10 月 7 日）是俄罗斯政治家、前情报官员，曾于 2000 至 2008 年以及 2012 年起担任俄罗斯总统。他还曾于 1999 至 2000 年、2008 至 2012 年两度担任俄罗斯总理。自 1999 年以来，他一直被视为俄罗斯的实际领导人。

en.s: The 2001 FA Women's Cup Final was the 31st final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The final event was played between Arsenal and Fulham on 6 May 2001 at Selhurst Park in London. Angela Banks of Arsenal scored the winner. A record 13,824 people attended the match.

zh.s: 这是第31届英格兰足总女子杯决赛，也是英格兰女子足球队的主要杯赛决赛。2001年5月6日，阿森纳与富勒姆在伦敦塞尔赫斯特公园球场交锋。阿森纳的安杰拉·班克斯打入制胜球，现场观众达创纪录的13,824人。

en.s: China Northern Airlines Flight 6136 (CBF6136, CJ6136) was a domestic passenger flight from Beijing Capital International Airport, Beijing to Dalian Zhoushuizi International Airport, in Dalian, Liaoning province, China. On May 7, 2002 the plane crashed into the bay near Dalian, shortly after the pilot reported "fire on board", killing all 103 passengers and 9 crew members.

zh.t: 中国北方航空6136号班机空难
zh.s: 中国北方航空6136号班机（航班代码CBF6136、CJ6136）是从北京首都国际机场飞往辽宁省大连市大连周水子国际机场的国内客运航班。2002年5月7日，机长报告“机上起火”后不久，飞机坠入大连附近海湾，103名乘客和9名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: EgyptAir Flight 843 was a flight from Cairo International Airport to Tunis–Carthage International Airport. On 7 May 2002, the Boeing 737-500 on the route crashed into a hill near Tunis–Carthage International Airport. Of the 6 crew members and 56 passengers, 3 crew members and 11 passengers died, making a total of 14 fatalities.

zh.s: 埃及航空843号班机从开罗国际机场飞往突尼斯-迦太基国际机场。2002年5月7日，执行该航线的波音737-500客机在突尼斯-迦太基国际机场附近撞山。机上有6名机组人员和56名乘客，其中3名机组人员和11名乘客遇难，共造成14人死亡。

en.s: The Iranian parliamentary elections of February 20 and May 7, 2004 were a victory for Islamic conservatives over the reformist parties. Assisting the conservative victory was the disqualification of about 2500 reformist candidates earlier in January.

zh.s: 伊朗议会选举于2004年2月20日和5月7日举行，伊斯兰保守派击败改革派政党。此前1月，约2,500名改革派候选人被取消资格，这也有助于保守派获胜。

en.t: American businessman Nick Berg is beheaded by Islamist militants. The act is recorded on videotape and released on the Internet
en.s: Nicholas Evan Berg (April 2, 1978 – May 7, 2004) was an American freelance radio-tower repairman who went to Iraq after the United States' invasion of Iraq. He was abducted and beheaded according to a video released in May 2004 by Islamist militants in response to the Abu Ghraib torture and prisoner abuse involving the United States Army and Iraqi prisoners.

zh.t: 美国商人尼克·伯格遭伊斯兰武装分子斩首
zh.s: 尼古拉斯·埃文·伯格（1978年4月2日—2004年5月7日）是美国自由职业者，从事无线电塔维修；美国入侵伊拉克后，他前往伊拉克。2004年5月，伊斯兰武装分子发布录像称将他绑架并斩首，以此回应阿布格莱布监狱虐囚事件；涉事者包括美国陆军人员和伊拉克囚犯。

en.s: An election to Essex County Council took place on 7 May 2005 as part of the 2005 United Kingdom local elections. 75 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were redrawn for this election. The Conservative Party retained control with an increased majority, winning 52 of the 75 seats.

zh.s: 埃塞克斯郡议会选举于2005年5月7日举行，是2005年英国地方选举的一部分。各选区按简单多数制选出一至两名郡议员，任期四年，共选出75人。本次选举调整了选区边界。保守党赢得75席中的52席，以更大的多数继续掌控议会。

en.s: On May 7 and June 7, 2005, the city of San Antonio, Texas held an election to choose who would serve as Mayor of San Antonio for a two-year term to expire in 2007. Phil Hardberger won in a runoff against Julian Castro. The election was officially nonpartisan.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥于2005年5月7日和6月7日举行选举，选出任期至2007年的市长。菲尔·哈德伯格在决选中击败朱利安·卡斯特罗。选举名义上不设党派。
zh.n: 此条记录的是源信息框所列事件的首轮投票日期。

en.s: The 2006 KNVB Cup final was a football match between Ajax and PSV on 7 May 2006 at De Kuip, Rotterdam. It was the final match of the 2005–06 KNVB Cup competition. Ajax won 2–1, both of their goals being scored by Klaas-Jan Huntelaar. Michael Lamey scored for PSV.

zh.s: 2006年荷兰杯决赛于2006年5月7日在鹿特丹德奎普球场举行，由阿贾克斯对阵埃因霍温，决出2005—06赛季荷兰杯冠军。阿贾克斯以2比1获胜，克拉斯-扬·亨特拉尔攻入两球；埃因霍温由迈克尔·拉梅伊进球。

en.s: The 2007 FA Women's Cup Final was the 37th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the 14th final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA). The final was contested between Arsenal and Charlton Athletic at the City Ground on 7 May 2007.

zh.s: 2007年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该项女子足球主要杯赛的第37场决赛，也是英格兰足总直接管理下举行的第14场决赛。阿森纳队与查尔顿竞技队于2007年5月7日在城市球场交锋。

en.s: The 2008 Albanian Cup final was the 56th final of the Albanian Cup. The final was played at Ruzhdi Bizhuta Stadium in Elbasan on 7 May 2008. The match was contested by Vllaznia, who beat Dinamo Tirana in their semi-final, and Tirana who beat Elbasani. Vllaznia opened the scoring in the 3rd minute with midfielder Gilman Lika, they then won the game with a second on 38 minutes through Xhevahir Sukaj to give Vllaznia their sixth Albanian Cup success.

zh.s: 2008年阿尔巴尼亚杯决赛是该项赛事的第56场决赛，于2008年5月7日在爱尔巴桑的鲁兹迪·比祖塔体育场举行。对阵双方是瓦拉兹尼亚和地拉那；瓦拉兹尼亚在半决赛击败地拉那迪纳摩，地拉那则击败爱尔巴桑晋级。瓦拉兹尼亚中场吉尔曼·利卡在第3分钟首开纪录，杰瓦希尔·苏卡伊在第38分钟再进一球，帮助球队获胜，夺得队史第六座阿尔巴尼亚杯。

en.s: The 2008 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the Metalist Stadium on May 7, 2008. The match was the 17th Ukrainian Cup Final and it was contested by Shakhtar Donetsk and Dynamo Kyiv. The 2008 Ukrainian Cup Final was the first to be held outside of the Ukrainian capital Kyiv. Shakhtar won the match 2–0 through goals from Oleksandr Gladkiy and Oleksiy Gai.

zh.s: 2008年乌克兰杯决赛于2008年5月7日在梅塔利斯特体育场举行，是第17届乌克兰杯决赛。顿涅茨克矿工队对阵基辅迪纳摩队。这是首次在乌克兰首都基辅以外举行的乌克兰杯决赛。顿涅茨克矿工以2比0获胜，奥列克桑德尔·格拉德基和奥列克西·盖各进一球。

en.s: The 2008 Turkish Cup final was a football match between Gençlerbirliği and Kayserispor and the final of the 2007–08 Turkish Cup. Kayserispor won 11–10 on penalties.

zh.s: 2008年土耳其杯决赛由根克勒比尔利吉队对阵开塞利体育队，决出2007—08赛季土耳其杯冠军。开塞利体育在点球大战中以11比10获胜。

en.s: An election to Devon County Council took place on 7 May 2009 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2009. The elections had been delayed from 7 May, to coincide with elections to the European Parliament. 62 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009. No elections were held in Plymouth and Torbay, which are unitary authorities outside the area covered by the County Council.

zh.s: 2009年5月7日举行德文郡议会选举，属于英国2009年地方选举的一部分。选举日期原从5月7日调整，以便与欧洲议会选举同日举行。选出62名议员，各选区通过简单多数制选出1名或2名议员，任期4年。此次选区划分与上届选举相同。普利茅斯和托贝属于郡议会辖区以外的单一制地方政府，因此没有举行选举。

en.s: The 2009 Indian general election in Delhi was held on 7 May 2009 to elect representatives of the 7 parliamentary constituencies in the union territory. The Indian National Congress won all the 7 seats of Delhi in the Lok Sabha, making it the third time it won all the seats in Delhi since 1952.

zh.s: 印度德里于2009年5月7日举行大选，选出联邦属地内7个议会选区的代表。印度国大党赢得德里全部7个人民院席位，这是该党自1952年以来第三次包揽德里所有席位。

en.s: The 2009 Indian general election in Haryana, occurred for 10 seats in the state.

zh.t: 2009年印度大选哈里亚纳邦选区
zh.s: 2009年印度大选在哈里亚纳邦改选10个席位。

en.s: Open The Northern Gate was a professional wrestling event produced by Dragon Gate USA.

zh.s: “开启北方之门”是由美国摔角推广机构Dragon Gate USA举办的一场职业摔角赛事。

en.s: Singapore's general election to form its 12th Parliament was held on 7 May 2011. The Parliament of Singapore's maximum term is five years, within which it must be dissolved by the President of Singapore and elections held within three months, as stated in the Constitution of Singapore. Voting is mandatory in Singapore and is based on the first-past-the-post system. Elections are conducted by the Elections Department, which is under the jurisdiction of the Prime Minister’s Office. On 19 April 2011, President S.R. Nathan dissolved parliament.

zh.s: 新加坡于2011年5月7日举行大选，选出第12届国会。根据新加坡宪法，国会最长任期为五年；在此期间，总统必须解散国会，并在三个月内举行选举。新加坡实行强制投票制和“先到先得”制。选举由隶属总理公署的选举局负责。2011年4月19日，总统塞拉潘·拉马纳坦解散国会。

en.s: General elections were held in Niue on 7 May 2011, to elect the members of the Niue Assembly. In the leadup to the election Speaker of the Niue Assembly Atapana Siakimotu announced that he would be retiring from politics.

zh.s: 纽埃于2011年5月7日举行大选，选出纽埃议会议员。选举前，纽埃议会议长阿塔帕纳·西亚基莫图宣布将退出政坛。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 7 May 2011. The three seats up for election were Launceston, held by retiring independent MLC Don Wing; Murchison, held by independent MLC Ruth Forrest; and Rumney, held by Labor MLC Lin Thorp. These seats were last contested in 2005. On the same day, a by-election was held for the seat of Derwent following the resignation of Labor MLC Michael Aird.

zh.t: 2011年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2011年5月7日举行。共有3个席位参加改选：劳恩斯顿席位由即将退休的独立议员唐·温担任，默奇森席位由独立议员露丝·福雷斯特担任，拉姆尼席位由工党议员琳·索普担任。这些席位上次于2005年改选。同日，德文特席位还举行了补选，此前工党议员迈克尔·艾尔德辞职。

en.s: The 2011 FA Trophy Final was the 42nd final of the Football Association's cup competition for levels 5–8 of the English football league system. The match was contested by Mansfield Town and Darlington. Neither team had ever reached the FA trophy final before, and had only recently become eligible for the FA trophy after Mansfield Town were relegated from League Two in 2008 and Darlington were relegated from League Two in 2010.

zh.s: 2011年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛是英格兰足总杯赛体系第5至第8级别球队参加的第42场决赛。对阵双方是曼斯菲尔德镇队和达灵顿队。此前两队都从未进入过英格兰足总锦标赛决赛；曼斯菲尔德镇于2008年、达灵顿于2010年从英乙降级后，才获得参加该项赛事的资格。

en.s: A parliamentary election to the Syrian People's Council was held in Syria on 7 May 2012, following the approval of a new constitution of Syria, in a referendum on 26 February 2012.

zh.s: 叙利亚于2012年5月7日举行人民议会选举。此前，叙利亚于2012年2月26日通过了新宪法。

en.s: A general election was held in the Bahamas on 7 May 2012. Elections in the Bahamas take place in the framework of a parliamentary democracy, which relies on the first past the post system of voting. This was the first general election in which a third party offered a full slate of candidates along with the two major parties.

zh.s: 巴哈马于2012年5月7日举行大选。巴哈马实行议会民主制，选举采用简单多数制。本次是第三大党首次与两大党一样，提名覆盖全部席位的候选人参加大选。

en.s: A traffic collision in Taiwan’s Hsuehshan Tunnel caused vehicles to catch fire. Two people died, and others were injured by smoke.

zh.t: 雪山隧道车辆起火事故
zh.s: 台湾雪山隧道内发生交通事故，车辆起火。事故造成2人死亡，另有多人吸入浓烟受伤。

en.t: South Carolina's 1st congressional district special election, 2013
en.s: A special election for South Carolina's 1st congressional district was held on May 7, 2013 to fill the seat following the resignation of U.S. Representative Tim Scott, who was appointed to the United States Senate by Governor Nikki Haley to fill the seat previously held by Jim DeMint. DeMint resigned from the Senate on January 1, 2013 to accept a position as president of The Heritage Foundation. The filing period for candidates lasted between January 18 and January 28, 2013. The special primary elections took place on March 19, 2013.

zh.t: 2013年南卡罗来纳州第一国会选区补选
zh.s: 南卡罗来纳州第一国会选区于2013年5月7日举行补选，填补蒂姆·斯科特辞职后留下的席位。州长妮基·黑利任命斯科特接替吉姆·德敏特进入美国参议院；德敏特于2013年1月1日辞去参议员职务，出任传统基金会主席。候选人登记期为2013年1月18日至28日，补选初选于3月19日举行。

en.s: The 2014 South African general election was held on 7 May 2014, to elect a new National Assembly and new provincial legislatures in each province. It was the fifth election held in South Africa under conditions of universal adult suffrage since the end of the apartheid era in 1994, and also the first held since the death of Nelson Mandela. It was also the first time that South African expatriates were allowed to vote in a South African national election. The National Assembly election was won by the African National Congress (ANC), but with a reduced majority of 62.1%, down from 65.9% in the 2009 election.

zh.s: 南非于2014年5月7日举行大选，选出新一届国民议会及各省议会。这是1994年种族隔离制度结束、实行普选以来举行的第五次选举，也是纳尔逊·曼德拉逝世后举行的首次选举。南非侨民也首次获准参加全国选举。非洲人国民大会赢得国民议会选举，但多数席位比例降至62.1%，低于2009年的65.9%。

en.s: A provincial election was held in the Western Cape on 7 May 2014 to elect a new provincial parliament. It was the fifth provincial election held since the end of the apartheid era, and also the first held since the death of Nelson Mandela. Although not constitutionally required, the election was held simultaneously with elections to the National Assembly.

zh.s: 西开普省于2014年5月7日举行省选举，选出新一届省议会。这是种族隔离结束后该省举行的第五次选举，也是纳尔逊·曼德拉逝世后的首次选举。宪法虽未要求两场选举同时举行，但本次省选与国民议会选举同日进行。

en.t: 2014 Indian general election in Jammu and Kashmir
en.s: The 2014 Indian general election in Jammu and Kashmir were held for 6 seats in the state. The voting process was held in five phases on 10, 17, 24, 30 April and 7 May 2014. Bharatiya Janata Party and Jammu and Kashmir People's Democratic Party won 3 seats each.

zh.t: 2014年印度大选查谟和克什米尔选区
zh.s: 2014年印度大选在查谟和克什米尔邦改选6个席位，投票分五轮进行，日期分别为4月10日、17日、24日、30日和5月7日。印度人民党和查谟和克什米尔人民民主党各赢得3席。

en.s: The 2014 Northern Cape provincial election was held on 7 May 2014 to elect all 30 members of the Northern Cape Provincial Legislature. As with all South African provincial elections, it was held concurrent with the 2014 South African general election. The ruling ANC gained a seat, and the opposition Democratic Alliance gained three seats. The Economic Freedom Fighters, founded less than a year earlier, won two seats.

zh.s: 北开普省于2014年5月7日举行省选举，改选省议会全部30名议员。与南非所有省级选举一样，本次选举与2014年南非大选同时举行。执政的非洲人国民大会增加1席，反对党民主联盟增加3席。成立还不到一年的经济自由斗士党赢得2席。

en.s: The 2014 Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly election took place on 30 April and 7 May 2014 to elect members to the legislatures of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. It was held concurrently with the Indian general election. The results were declared on 16 May 2014. The Telugu Desam Party led by N. Chandrababu Naidu won a majority of the 175 seats in the residual Andhra Pradesh, while Telangana Rashtra Samithi led by K.

zh.t: 2014 年安得拉邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 2014 年安得拉邦立法议会选举于 4 月 30 日和 5 月 7 日举行，选出安得拉邦和特伦甘纳邦议会成员。选举与印度大选同期举行。结果于 2014 年 5 月 16 日公布。由 N. 钱德拉巴布·奈杜领导的泰卢固之乡党赢得分治后安得拉邦 175 个席位中的多数；由 K. 钱德拉谢卡尔·拉奥领导的特伦甘纳民族委员会则在新成立的特伦甘纳邦获胜。

en.t: 2014 Indian general election in Himachal Pradesh
en.s: The 2014 Indian general election in Himachal Pradesh were held for 4 seats in the state. The major two contenders in the state were Bharatiya Janta Party (BJP) and the Indian National Congress (INC). The voting process was held in a single phase on 7 May 2014.

zh.t: 2014年印度大选喜马偕尔邦选区
zh.s: 2014年印度大选在喜马偕尔邦改选4个席位。该邦主要竞争者为印度人民党和印度国大党，投票于5月7日一次完成。

en.s: The 2014 Turkish Cup final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2013–14 Turkish Cup, the 52nd edition of Turkey's primary football cup. The match was played on 7 May 2014 at the Atatürk Stadium in Konya between Galatasaray and Eskişehirspor. Galatasaray won 1–0 for their first Turkish Cup title.

zh.s: 2014年土耳其杯决赛决出2013—14赛季土耳其杯冠军，这是土耳其主要足球杯赛的第52届赛事。比赛于2014年5月7日在科尼亚阿塔图尔克体育场举行，加拉塔萨雷对阵埃斯基谢希尔体育。加拉塔萨雷以1比0获胜，首次夺得土耳其杯。

en.s: The 2014 Indian general election in Uttarakhand, occurred for 5 seats in the state. All 5 seats were won by the Bharatiya Janata Party.

zh.t: 2014年印度大选北阿坎德邦选区
zh.s: 2014年印度大选在北阿坎德邦改选5个席位，印度人民党赢得全部5席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2014 Taça da Liga final was the final match of the 2013–14 Taça da Liga, the seventh season of the Taça da Liga. Benfica defeated Rio Ave 2–0 to win a record fifth title in the competition.

zh.s: 2014年葡萄牙联赛杯决赛决出2013—14赛季冠军，这是该项赛事的第七个赛季。本菲卡以2比0击败里奥阿维，创纪录地第五次夺冠。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2015 Cotswold District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect all members of Cotswold District Council in England. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was substantially up across the district due to the election being held on the same day as the general election and other local elections in England. Boundary changes had reduced the number of seats from 44 to 34, making exact comparisons with 2011 difficult. The election produced a slightly reduced majority for the ruling Conservative Group but other than a single gain by the Liberal Democrats to produce this result no other ward changed hands.

zh.s: 2015年科茨沃尔德区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰科茨沃尔德区议会全部议员。投票率大幅上升，因为选举与英国大选及英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选区边界调整使席位从44席减至34席，因此难以与2011年选举直接比较。结果显示，执政的保守党团多数略有减少；除自由民主党赢得一个席位外，没有其他选区发生政党轮替。

en.t: North West Leicestershire District Council election, 2015
en.s: Elections to elect all members of the North West Leicestershire District Council took place on 7 May 2015, simultaneously with a general election, held as one of the English local elections of that year. At the request of the previous administration, a boundary review took place during 2014 with a view to make every ward represented by one councillor. The total number of councillors remained at 38, meaning that the final proposals from the Local Government Boundary Commission for England replaced 20 single-, double- and triple-member wards with 38, single-member. The local Conservative governing group increased their previous majority of two gained at the previous election.

zh.t: 2015年西北莱斯特郡区议会选举
zh.s: 西北莱斯特郡区议会全部议员的选举于2015年5月7日举行，与英国大选同时进行，是当年英格兰地方选举的一部分。应上届政府要求，区内于2014年进行选区边界审查，计划让每个选区选出1名议员。议员总数仍为38人，英格兰地方政府边界委员会的最终方案因此将20个单席、双席和三席选区调整为38个单席选区。保守党执政团体扩大了上次选举中取得的2席多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The by-thirds 2015 Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on Thursday 7 May 2015, to elect approximately one third of the members of the Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council in England as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2015 held on the same day as the general election. All seats contested at this election were last contested in 2011, and of these, 20 were held by Labour Party councillors. Following the premature resignation of former Cabinet member Cllr. Mahroof Hussain (L) elected in Boston Castle at a more recent election, his seat (for the Boston Castle ward) was also contested in the 2015 election.

zh.t: 2015年罗瑟勒姆都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 罗瑟勒姆都市自治市议会按三分之一席位轮流改选，2015年选举于5月7日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰罗瑟勒姆都市自治市议会议员，是2015年英国地方选举的一部分，与英国大选同日进行。本次参选席位上次于2011年改选，其中20席由工党议员担任。此前，波士顿城堡选区议员马赫鲁夫·侯赛因提前辞职，因此该席位也在本次选举中改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This is on the same day as other local elections and the UK General Election. Stockport Council is elected in thirds which means that in each three member local ward, one councillor is elected every year, except every four years which is classed as fallow year. The last fallow year was 2013, when no local government elections took place in the borough. Those councillors elected with serve a four-year term expiring in 2019.

zh.t: 2015年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年斯托克波特都市自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰斯托克波特都市自治市议会议员，与地方选举及英国大选同日进行。斯托克波特议会按三分之一席位轮流改选：在每个有3名议员的地方选区中，每年选出1名议员；每四年有一年不举行选举。上一次不举行地方选举的空档年是2013年。2015年当选议员任期四年，到2019年届满。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United Kingdom general election of 2015 on 7 May 2015 elected the 56th Parliament of the United Kingdom. Each of the 650 parliamentary constituencies elected one Member of Parliament to the House of Commons, the dominant house of Parliament. It was the first general election at the end of a fixed term Parliament. Local elections took place in most of England on the same day. Polls and commentators had predicted the outcome would be too close to call and would result in a second hung parliament similar to the 2010 election.

zh.s: 英国于2015年5月7日举行大选，选出第56届英国议会。全国650个议会选区各选出1名下议院议员。该届大选是英国首次在完整固定任期结束时举行的大选。英格兰大部分地区同日也举行地方选举。民调机构和评论人士原先认为选情难分胜负，可能再次出现类似2010年的悬峙议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Calderdale in England. This was on the same day as other local elections and a general election. One councillor was elected in each ward for a four-year term so the councillors elected in 2015 last stood for election in 2011. Each ward is represented by three councillors, the election of which is staggered, so only one third of the councillors were elected in this election. Before the election there was no overall control with a minority Labour administration which was over-ruled at a recent Budget vote by a coalition of Conservatives & Liberal Democrats.

zh.t: 2015年卡尔德代尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年卡尔德代尔都市自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰卡尔德代尔议会议员，与其他地方选举及英国大选同日进行。各选区选出1名议员，任期四年，因此2015年当选者上次参加选举是在2011年。该议会由每区3名议员代表，每年改选三分之一。选举前，议会没有任何政党占据多数，由工党少数派政府执政；在最近一次预算表决中，该政府被保守党和自由民主党组成的联盟推翻。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Newcastle City Council Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect one third of the members of Newcastle City Council in England. The elections took place on the same day as other local elections. During the election campaign, hustings were held by JesmondLocal in the North and South Jesmond Wards. The result saw the majority of governing Labour Party members increase in the council chamber, with winners in seats in the wards Castle and North Jesmond replacing one Liberal Democrat councillor each for these. Westerhope saw its third independent councillor elected, Pat Hillicks winning the seat with a 1,319 majority over the Labour Party candidate.

zh.s: 2015年纽卡斯尔市议会选举于5月7日举行，改选英格兰纽卡斯尔市议会三分之一的议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。竞选期间，JesmondLocal在北杰斯蒙德和南杰斯蒙德选区举行了候选人问答会。选举后，执政工党在议会中的多数有所扩大。卡斯尔和北杰斯蒙德选区的当选者分别取代了自由民主党议员。韦斯特霍普选区第三次选出无党籍议员，帕特·希利克斯以1,319票优势击败工党候选人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 City of York Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of City of York Council in England. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was substantially up across the city due to the election being held on the same day as the general election and other local elections in England. Since the previous election in 2011 a review of ward boundaries had affected some wards, although the total number of councillors remained at 47. The following wards remained unchanged from 2011: Acomb, Bishopthorpe, Dringhouses and Woodthorpe, Haxby and Wigginton, Holgate, Huntington and New Earswick, Micklegate, Strensall, Westfield and Wheldrake.

zh.s: 2015年约克市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰约克市议会议员。议会全部席位都进行改选。由于选举与英国大选及英格兰其他地方选举同日举行，全市投票率大幅上升。自2011年上次选举以来，部分选区边界经过审查，但议员总数仍为47人。阿科姆、毕晓普索普、德林豪斯和伍德索普、哈克斯比和威格顿、霍尔盖特、亨廷顿和纽伊尔斯威克、米克尔盖特、斯特伦索尔、西菲尔德和惠特德尔选区边界维持不变。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Medway Council election took place on 7 May 2015, alongside the 2015 UK General Election. The elections were to elect all 55 seats across 22 wards. The Conservatives held the council, with 36 seats (a majority of 16). The Labour Party has 15 seats, and UKIP has 4. Following the announcement of the results, the Trade Unionist and Socialist Coalition called for a re-count in Rainham North ward after their candidate received no votes, despite claiming that he had voted for himself; however, the council's returning officer confirmed that the result was correct and no further action could be taken.

zh.s: 2015年梅德韦议会选举于5月7日举行，与英国大选同时进行。22个选区共改选全部55席。保守党继续掌控议会，赢得36席，多数席位为16席；工党赢得15席，英国独立党赢得4席。结果公布后，工会主义者和社会主义者联盟要求在雷纳姆北选区重新计票，原因是该党候选人得票为0票，尽管他声称自己也投了自己的票。议会选举主任确认结果无误，无法采取进一步行动。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 South Norfolk District Council election was held on Thursday 7 May 2015 to elect the whole council as part of United Kingdom local elections, 2015 coinciding with the general election. The council continued to consist of 46 councillors and as immediately after the previous election, the council was controlled by local Conservatives, with local Liberal Democrats being the only opposition. The governing group's numbers were augmented by two councillors at the expense of that opposition group. Three defecting-from-majority independent councillors lost their council seats.

zh.s: 南诺福克区议会选举于2015年5月7日（星期四）举行，与英国大选同时进行。议会全部46席都进行改选。与上次选举后一样，地方保守党继续掌控议会，自由民主党是唯一反对党。执政团体从反对党手中增加2席；3名原本属于多数派的无党籍议员则失去席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Southampton City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Southampton City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. After the election, the composition of the council was * Labour 26 (-2) * Conservative 20 (+2) * Councillors Against Cuts 2 Just one week after the election, newly re-elected Labour councillor for Redbridge, Andrew Pope, who had represented the area since 2011, left Labour to sit as an independent, citing concerns he had with the leader of the council, Simon Letts, who he accused of "putting his own position ahead of the people of Southampton" and of lacking "vision and strong leadership".

zh.s: 2015年南安普敦市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰南安普敦市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。选后议会席位为：工党26席（减少2席）、保守党20席（增加2席）、反对削减开支议员团2席。选举一周后，代表雷德布里奇选区、2011年以来一直任职的工党议员安德鲁·波普脱离工党，以无党籍身份留在议会。他称对市议会领袖西蒙·莱茨不满，指责对方“把自己的位置放在南安普敦市民之前”，缺乏“远见和有力领导”。

en.t: Brighton and Hove City Council election, 2015
en.s: The 2015 Brighton and Hove City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Brighton and Hove City Council in England. This is on the same day as the general election and other local elections. The election saw the Green party lose their minority control of the council. The party had gained control of the council from the Conservative party following the previous election, with the party elected on a promise to resist cuts from central government. During the administration however the council was faced with cuts of up to £80 million.

zh.t: 2015年布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰布莱顿和霍夫市议会议员，与英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。绿党失去对议会的少数派控制权。该党在上次选举后从保守党手中赢得议会控制权，竞选时承诺反对中央政府削减开支；执政期间，议会却面临高达8,000万英镑的削减。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Birmingham City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Birmingham City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections, and also the 2015 UK General Election. In Birmingham the Labour Party went against the trend across the United Kingdom, as they lost the General Election the Labour Party managed to strengthen its hold on Birmingham City Council as well as performing well in the Westminster seats. This is despite the problems facing the Council in the form of the recent Operation Trojan Horse scandal and the Kerslake review, which was highly critical of Birmingham City Council.

zh.s: 2015年伯明翰市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰伯明翰市议会议员，与其他地方选举及英国大选同日进行。英国大选中工党失利，但在伯明翰，工党反而加强了对市议会的控制，在西敏寺议会席位上也表现良好。这是在市议会近期卷入“特洛伊木马”丑闻并受到克斯莱克审查严厉批评的情况下取得的。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Norwich City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect approximately one third of the members of Norwich City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections and the UK general election. Thirteen seats were due to be contested, with a further two seats up for election where casual vacancies had arisen. Labour won ten of the available seats, the Green Party won four, and the Liberal Democrats one. The Conservatives gained their highest ever vote in many city wards including Town Close and Thorpe Hamlet, and across Norwich came within almost 2000 votes of the Green Party, however failed to gain any seats.

zh.s: 2015年诺里奇市议会选举于5月7日举行，改选英格兰诺里奇市议会约三分之一议员，与其他地方选举及英国大选同日进行。原定改选13席，另有两个席位因临时空缺参加选举。工党赢得10席，绿党赢得4席，自由民主党赢得1席。保守党在多处选区的得票率创下新高，包括汤克洛斯和索普哈姆雷特选区；但在诺里奇全市仍以近2,000票落后于绿党，未能赢得任何席位。

en.s: The 2015 Tendring District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Tendring District Council in England. This is on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年滕德灵区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰滕德灵区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Cambridge City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in England as part of the English local elections of that year coinciding with the 2015 General Election.

zh.s: 2015年剑桥市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰剑桥市议会议员。该选举是当年英格兰地方选举的一部分，与2015年英国大选同日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Bristol City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. This is on the same day as other local elections. In March 2015, the only Independent Councillor on Bristol City Council defected to the Conservatives. This meant that the Conservatives increased their number of seats from the previous Council despite making no gains in the May election.

zh.s: 2015年布里斯托市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰布里斯托市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。2015年3月，布里斯托市议会唯一的独立议员转投保守党。因此，保守党的席位数比上一届议会有所增加，尽管它在5月选举中没有赢得任何新增席位。

en.s: The 2015 Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年达德利自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰达德利自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 West Dorset District Council election took take place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of West Dorset District Council in England. This was on the same day as the general election and other local elections. A series of boundary changes saw the number of councillors reduced from 48 to 44.

zh.s: 2015年西多塞特区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰西多塞特区议会议员，日期与英国大选及其他地方选举相同。选区边界经过一系列调整后，议员人数从48人减至44人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect all the members of Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England to coincide with other local elections, an election which was held simultaneously with the 2015 General Election, resulting in higher turnout than the previous election.

zh.t: 2015年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举

zh.s: 2015年莱斯特市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰莱斯特市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举、2015年英国大选和莱斯特市长直选相同。

en.s: The 2015 Test Valley Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Test Valley Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2015年泰斯特谷自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年泰斯特谷自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰泰斯特谷自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.t: 2015 Forest of Dean District Council election
en.s: Elections for all seats on Forest of Dean District Council were held on 7 May 2015 as part of the 2015 United Kingdom local elections. No party gained overall control. The Conservatives remained the largest party on the council, having increased their number of Councillors, but failing to gain an overall majority. This election saw the Green Party gain their first seats on the council, while the Liberal Democrats lost their only Councillor.

zh.s: 迪恩森林区议会全部席位于2015年5月7日进行改选，是2015年英国地方选举的一部分。没有任何政党取得多数。保守党议员人数有所增加，仍是议会第一大党，但未能获得多数。绿党首次在该议会赢得席位，自由民主党则失去了唯一一席。

en.t: 2015 United Kingdom general election in Wales
en.s: On Thursday 7 May 2015, the 2015 United Kingdom general election was held in Wales, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, with 40 constituencies being in Wales. The election for each seat was conducted on the basis of first-past-the-post. Despite the Labour party winning the most votes in Wales, the Conservatives won across the UK.

zh.s: 2015年英国大选于2015年5月7日（星期四）在威尔士举行，选出下议院全部650名议员，其中40个选区位于威尔士。每个席位采用简单多数制选出。尽管工党在威尔士获得最多选票，保守党仍在全英国胜出。

en.s: The 2015 Lewes District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Lewes District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年刘易斯区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰刘易斯区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Horsham District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections and the 2015 United Kingdom general election. The Conservatives secured a majority of 17, which was the largest majority any party has ever achieved at a Horsham District Council election.

zh.s: 2015年霍舍姆区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会议员，与其他地方选举及2015年英国大选同日进行。保守党赢得17席多数，这是该党在霍舍姆区议会选举中取得的最大多数。

en.s: The 2015 Luton Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Luton Borough Council in Bedfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年卢顿自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰贝德福德郡卢顿自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Braintree District Council election was scheduled to take place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Following a boundary change, the number of wards was reduced from 30 to 26 and the number of councillors from 60 to 49.

zh.s: 布伦特里区议会选举原定于2015年5月7日举行，选出英格兰布伦特里区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。选区边界调整后，选区数量从30个减至26个，议员人数从60人减至49人。

en.t: 2015 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland
en.s: The 2015 United Kingdom general election in Northern Ireland was held on 7 May 2015 and all 18 seats were contested. 1,236,765 people were eligible to vote, up 67,581 from the 2010 general election. 58.45% of eligible voters turned out, an increase of half a percentage point from the last general election. This election saw the return of Ulster Unionists to the House of Commons, after they targeted 4 seats but secured 2.

zh.s: 2015年英国大选北爱尔兰选区投票于5月7日举行，全部18个席位参加竞选。共有1,236,765人符合投票资格，比2010年大选增加67,581人。符合资格的选民中有58.45%投票，比上届大选增加0.5个百分点。阿尔斯特统一党重返下议院。该党曾将4个席位列为目标，最终赢得2席。

en.t: 2015 United Kingdom general election in Scotland
en.s: A general election was held in the United Kingdom on 7 May 2015 and all 59 seats in Scotland were contested under the first-past-the-post, single-member district electoral system. Unlike the 2010 general election, where no seats changed party, the Scottish National Party (SNP) won all but three seats in Scotland, gaining a total of 56 seats.

zh.s: 英国于2015年5月7日举行大选，苏格兰全部59席参加竞选，采用单议席选区简单多数制。2010年大选没有席位易手，而本次苏格兰民族党赢得全部席位中的56席，仅有3席未能拿下。

en.s: The 2015 South Gloucestershire Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of South Gloucestershire Council in England as part of nationwide local elections. For the first time since the creation of South Gloucestershire, the Conservatives took an overall majority with 40 of the 70 seats. This was the second one-party majority in the history of South Gloucestershire, after the Lib Dems' 1999-2003 control.

zh.s: 2015年南格洛斯特郡议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰南格洛斯特郡议会议员，是全国地方选举的一部分。南格洛斯特郡成立以来，保守党首次取得多数，赢得70席中的40席。这是该郡历史上第二次由单一政党取得多数；此前一次是自由民主党于1999年至2003年执政。

en.s: The 2015 Derbyshire Dales District Council election was held on 7 May 2015 to elect all 39 members of Derbyshire Dales District Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained control of the council for the fourth consecutive election, with a majority of 19.

zh.t: 2015年德比郡戴尔斯区议会选举
zh.s: 德比郡戴尔斯区议会选举于2015年5月7日举行，改选全部39名议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党连续第四次选举后继续掌控议会，多数席位为19席。

en.s: The 2015 Kettering Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Kettering Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained control of the council, which it had held since 2003. The election in Rothwell Ward was delayed until 4 June 2015 due to the death of a candidate.

zh.s: 2015年凯特林自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰凯特林自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。自2003年以来一直掌控议会的保守党继续执政。罗斯韦尔选区一名候选人去世，因此该区选举延期至2015年6月4日举行。

en.s: The 2015 Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council election was scheduled to take place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2019. The Conservative Party held overall control of the council.

zh.t: 2015年特拉福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 特拉福德自治市议会选举原定于2015年5月7日举行，选出英格兰特拉福德自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。议会三分之一席位参加改选，当选议员任期四年，至2019年届满。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 2015 Brentwood Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Brentwood Borough Council in England. They were held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2015年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰布伦特伍德自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Mansfield District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Mansfield District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年曼斯菲尔德区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰曼斯菲尔德区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Borough Council of Wellingborough election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Borough Council of Wellingborough in Northamptonshire, UK. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2015年韦灵伯勒自治市议会选举
zh.s: 韦灵伯勒自治市议会选举于2015年5月7日举行，选出英国北安普敦郡韦灵伯勒自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Teignbridge District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Teignbridge District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. At the election, the Conservatives won control of the council.

zh.s: 2015年蒂恩布里奇区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德文郡蒂恩布里奇区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党在本次选举中取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2015 Rushmoor Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Rushmoor Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. Two seats were up for election in the West Heath ward due to the resignation of an incumbent.

zh.t: 2015年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰拉什穆尔自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。西希思选区因一名在任议员辞职，有两个席位参加改选。

en.s: The 2015 Poole Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Poole Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections and the Parliamentary General Election.

zh.s: 2015年普尔自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰普尔自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举及英国大选相同。

en.s: The Arun District Council elections, 2015 took place on Thursday 7 May 2015, electing all 54 members of the council, and taking place alongside a general election and other local elections in England. From the previous election, the council had undergone boundary changes which had reduced their number by 2. One councillor in Bersted had defected from the Liberal Democrats to the Green Party, bringing in the first Green councillor on Arun since the authority was formed in 1973.

zh.s: 阿伦区议会选举于2015年5月7日（星期四）举行，改选全部54名议员，与英国大选及英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。自上次选举以来，选区边界有所调整，议会席位减少2席。伯斯特德选区一名议员从自由民主党转投绿党，使绿党自该机构1973年成立以来首次在议会拥有议员。

en.s: The 2015 Havant Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Havant Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年哈文特自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰哈文特自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 North Norfolk District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the North Norfolk District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年北诺福克区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰北诺福克区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Hart District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Hart District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. Prior to this elections, the Conservatives held a plurality with 14 seats but did not hold a majority, whilst the Liberal Democrats and Community Campaign (Hart) both had 8 seats.

zh.s: 2015年哈特区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰哈特区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。选举前，保守党以14席成为议会第一大党，但没有取得多数；自由民主党和社区竞选团体（哈特）各有8席。

en.s: The 2015 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections and the 2015 general election. The Conservative Party retained its control of the council, winning every seat that was up for election. There was no local election in Durrington or Northbrook wards this year.

zh.s: 2015年沃辛自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰沃辛自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举及2015年英国大选同日进行。保守党继续掌控议会，赢得全部改选席位。今年达灵顿和诺思布鲁克选区没有举行地方选举。

en.s: The 2015 Rochford District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Rochford District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年罗奇福德区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰罗奇福德区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.t: 2015 St Albans City and District Council election
en.s: The 2015 St Albans City and District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of St Albans City and District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2015年圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举
zh.s: 2015年圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰圣奥尔本斯市和区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Corby Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Corby Borough Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since 1979.

zh.s: 2015年科比自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡科比自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。自1979年以来一直掌控议会的工党继续执政。

en.s: The 2015 South Northamptonshire District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of South Northamptonshire District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2015年南北安普敦郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2015年南北安普敦郡区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰南北安普敦郡区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Gravesham Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Gravesham Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party gained control of the council from the Labour Party.

zh.t: 2015年格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰格雷夫舍姆自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党从工党手中取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2015 South Lakeland District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the South Lakeland District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年南湖区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰南湖区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 North Lincolnshire Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the North Lincolnshire Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The election resulted in the Conservative Party retaining control of the council.

zh.s: 2015年北林肯郡议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰北林肯郡议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 2015 Maldon District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Maldon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as the 2015 general election and other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年马尔登区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡马尔登区议会议员，日期与2015年英国大选及其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 South Oxfordshire District Council election was held on 7 May 2015 to elect members of South Oxfordshire District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Elections were held for all seats on the council. After the 2011 South Oxfordshire District Council election the Boundary Commission for England had revised South Oxfordshire's district ward boundaries and reduced the number of seats from 48 to 36. the 2015 elections were the first to be held for the new revised wards.

zh.s: 南牛津郡区议会全部席位于2015年5月7日进行改选，选出英格兰南牛津郡区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。2011年选举后，英格兰选举委员会调整了南牛津郡区议会的选区边界，议席从48席减至36席。2015年是新选区划分后的首次选举。

en.s: The 2015 Selby District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Selby District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年塞尔比区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰塞尔比区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Dover District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Dover District Council in Kent, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2015年多佛区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡多佛区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.t: 2015 United Kingdom general election in England
en.s: On Thursday 7 May 2015, the 2015 United Kingdom general election was held in England, to elect all 650 members of the House of Commons, with 533 constituencies being in England. The Conservatives won a majority of seats in England for the second time since 1992. Both major parties made gains at the expense of the Liberal Democrats, whose support collapsed to its lowest level since 1970.

zh.s: 2015年英国大选于2015年5月7日（星期四）在英格兰举行，选出下议院全部650名议员，其中533个选区位于英格兰。保守党第二次在英格兰赢得多数席位，此前一次是1992年。两大党都从自由民主党手中赢得席位；自由民主党的支持率跌至1970年以来最低。

en.s: The 2015 Breckland District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Breckland District Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as the 2015 general election and other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new ward boundaries, decreasing the number of seats by 5 to 49.

zh.s: 2015年布雷克兰区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡布雷克兰区议会议员，与2015年英国大选及其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位按新选区边界改选，席位减少5席至49席。

en.s: The 2015 Derby City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Derby City Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party increased its majority on the council by gaining two seats.

zh.s: 2015年德比市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。工党赢得2席，扩大了在议会的多数优势。

en.s: The 2015 Canterbury City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the Canterbury City Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. It was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2015年坎特伯雷市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰肯特郡坎特伯雷市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。本次是新选区边界下的首次选举，保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 2015 Chichester District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Chichester District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年奇切斯特区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰奇切斯特区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 New Forest District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of New Forest District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年新森林区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰新森林区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Sunderland City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Sunderland City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections, and the 2015 general election.

zh.s: 2015年桑德兰市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰桑德兰市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举及2015年英国大选相同。

en.s: The 2015 Exeter City Council election took place on 7 May 2015, to elect members of Exeter City Council in Exeter, Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年埃克塞特市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Bassetlaw District Council election took place on 7 May 2015, to elect all 48 members of Bassetlaw District Council in England. This was on the same day as the 2015 general election and other local elections. Prior to this election, the council decided to move to all-out elections from 2015.

zh.s: 2015年巴塞特洛区议会选举于5月7日举行，改选英格兰巴塞特洛区议会全部48名议员，日期与英国大选及其他地方选举相同。议会决定从2015年起改为整届同时选举。

en.s: The 2015 East Hampshire District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of the East Hampshire District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The election saw the Conservatives maintain their majority, whilst the Liberal Democrats, the only other party to hold representation on the council, lost three seats to the Conservatives, all in Whitehill.

zh.s: 2015年东汉普郡区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰东汉普郡区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党继续保持多数，自由民主党是议会中唯一的另一政党，但在怀特希尔选区输给保守党3席。

en.t: 2015 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election
en.s: The 2015 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2015年布莱克本-达温自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年布莱克本-达温自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰布莱克本-达温自治市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Chelmsford City Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Chelmsford City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2015年切姆斯福德市议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰切姆斯福德市议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。

en.s: The 2015 Daventry District Council election took place on 7 May 2015 to elect members of Daventry District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Two seats changed hands with the Conservatives taking both from Labour leading to the council being made up as follows; 31 Conservative councillors, 2 Labour councillors, 2 UKIP councillors and 1 Liberal Democrat councillor.

zh.s: 2015年达文特里区议会选举于5月7日举行，选出英格兰达文特里区议会议员，日期与其他地方选举相同。保守党从工党手中赢得2席，席位分布为：保守党31席、工党2席、英国独立党2席、自由民主党1席。

en.s: Elections to Central Bedfordshire Council were held on 7 May 2015, along with the 2015 United Kingdom general election and other local elections. The whole council was up for election, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2019. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council, winning 53 of the 59 seats on the council.

zh.s: 中贝德福德郡议会选举于2015年5月7日举行，与2015年英国大选及其他地方选举同日。议会全部席位参加改选，当选议员任期四年，至2019年届满。保守党赢得59席中的53席，继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Warwick District Council took place on Thursday 7 May 2015, with votes counted and declared on Saturday 9 May 2015. A total of 46 seats were up for election, all councillors from all wards. The previous elections produced a majority for the Conservative Party. The boundaries of many of the wards across the District were changed from the previous election.

zh.s: 沃里克区议会选举于2015年5月7日（星期四）举行，计票和结果公布日期为5月9日（星期六）。议会全部46席都参加改选，覆盖所有选区。上届选举后，保守党在议会占多数。自上届选举以来，该区多个选区的边界经过调整。

en.s: The 2015 North Hertfordshire Council election was held on 7 May 2015, at the same time as other local elections and the general election. Of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council, 16 were up for election. The Conservatives increased their majority on the council. They gained two seats, one from Labour and one from the Liberal Democrats.

zh.t: 2015年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会选举于2015年5月7日举行，与其他地方选举及英国大选同日。该区议会49席中有16席参加改选。保守党扩大了议会多数，分别从工党和自由民主党手中赢得1席。

en.s: The 2015 Northampton Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015 as a four-yearly public decision to elect all members of the council. This took place on the same day as other local elections and the 2015 United Kingdom general election – when there is a general election on the same day as the local elections, turnout across the country is almost always higher than if there is no general election.

zh.t: 2015年北安普敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2015年北安普敦自治市议会选举于5月7日举行，每四年一次，选出议会全部议员。选举与其他地方选举及2015年英国大选同日举行。地方选举与大选同日进行时，全国投票率几乎总是高于没有大选同时举行的情况。

en.s: The 2015 Basildon Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2015, as part of the 2015 United Kingdom local elections, and took place alongside the UK General Election. One third of seats were up for election, with these seats last being contested in 2011. As a result of the election, the council remained in no overall control. The Conservative Party remained as the largest party, and formed a minority administration.

zh.t: 2015年巴西尔登自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴西尔登自治市议会选举于2015年5月7日举行，是2015年英国地方选举的一部分，并与英国大选同时进行。议会三分之一席位参加改选，这些席位上次于2011年改选。选后仍没有任何政党占据议会多数。保守党仍是议会第一大党，并组建少数派政府。

en.s: The 2015 Thanet District Council election was held on 7 May 2015 to elect all 56 seats on Thanet District Council, as part of the 2015 United Kingdom local elections taking place simultaneously with the 2015 General Election. The UK Independence Party won control of the council, becoming the governing group, the first time UKIP had won control of any type of local government unit above the level of a civil parish council, whether London Borough, Metropolitan Borough, Unitary Authority, Non-Metropolitan Borough or a District Council.

zh.s: 塞尼特区议会选举于2015年5月7日举行，改选全部56席，是与2015年英国大选同时举行的英国地方选举之一。英国独立党赢得议会控制权并组建政府。这是该党首次控制民政教区议会以上层级的地方政府，无论是伦敦自治市、大都会自治市、单一制地方政府、非大都会自治市还是区议会。

en.s: Sheffield City Council elections took place on Thursday 7 May 2015, the same day as the UK general election and local Parish Council elections. There were 28 seats up for election, one of the three councillors from each ward.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2015年5月7日（星期四）举行，与英国大选和地方教区议会选举同日。议会28席参加改选，每个选区从三名议员中改选一人。

en.s: Elections to South Hams District Council took place on 7 May, the same day as other United Kingdom local elections and the General Election. 19 of the 20 wards were up for election, each with either 1, 2 or 3 councillors to be elected. The number of seats up for election in each ward is indicated by the number in the brackets following the ward name.

zh.s: 南哈姆斯区议会选举于5月7日举行，日期与英国其他地方选举及大选相同。20个选区中有19个参加改选，每个选区选出1至3名议员。各选区改选席位数列在选区名称后的括号中。

en.s: The Wisbech Town Council elections were held the same time as the 2015 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.s: 威斯贝奇镇议会选举与2015年英国地方选举同时举行。

en.s: A by-thirds Hyndburn Borough Council local election took place on 7 May 2015. Approximately one third of the second tier council's 35 seats fell up for election, and the General Election was held on the same day.

zh.t: 2015年亨德伯恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 亨德伯恩自治市议会分批改选于2015年5月7日举行。35席中约三分之一参加改选。这一天也举行英国大选。

en.s: A by-election for the Bukit Batok Single Member Constituency in Singapore was concluded on Polling Day of 7 May 2016, with Murali Pillai as the winning candidate. This followed the sudden resignation of incumbent Member of Parliament David Ong Kim Huat (of the People's Action Party) on 12 March 2016. On 20 April, President Tony Tan Keng Yam issued the writs of election. On 27 April, two candidates were nominated, Murali Pillai of the People's Action Party, and Chee Soon Juan of the Singapore Democratic Party. The by-election was the 13th of its kind since Singapore's independence.

zh.s: 新加坡武吉巴督单议席选区于2016年5月7日完成补选投票，人民行动党候选人穆拉利·皮莱胜出。此前，该党现任议员王金发于2016年3月12日突然辞职。4月20日，总统陈庆炎发布选举令；4月27日，人民行动党的穆拉利·皮莱和新加坡民主党的谢顺全获提名参选。这是新加坡独立以来的第13场补选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The eleventh Sarawak state election was held on Saturday, 7 May 2016 after nomination for candidates on Monday, 25 April 2016. The 82 members of the Sarawak State Legislative Assembly, were elected in single-member constituencies using first-past-the-post voting. More than 1.1 million who had their names entered or retained in an electoral register for a particular electoral district in Sarawak was eligible to vote at the time of the election. Malaysia does not practice compulsory voting and automatic voter registration. The voting age is 21 although the age of majority in the country is 18.

zh.s: 砂拉越第11届州选举于2016年5月7日（星期六）举行，候选人提名日为4月25日。砂拉越州议会82席从各单议席选区选出，采用“先到先得”制。登记在特定砂拉越选区名册上或保留在名册上的选民超过110万人，有资格参加本次投票。马来西亚不实行强制投票或自动选民登记，法定投票年龄为21岁，尽管该国成年年龄为18岁。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 7 May 2016. The two seats up for election were the electoral division of Apsley and the electoral division of Elwick. These seats were last contested in 2010.

zh.t: 2016年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2016年5月7日举行。两个选区参加改选，分别为阿普斯利和埃尔威克；这些席位上次于2010年改选。

en.s: The 2016 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Surrey Storm and Manchester Thunder. Having previously played each other in 2012 and 2014, this was the third grand final featuring both teams. Thunder had won both the previous encounters. This was also Surrey Storm's third consecutive grand final, having lost to Thunder in 2014, they defeated Hertfordshire Mavericks in 2015.

zh.t: 2016年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2016年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛由萨里风暴队对阵曼彻斯特雷霆队。这是两队第三次在总决赛交手，此前曾于2012年和2014年相遇，曼彻斯特雷霆两次都获胜。萨里风暴连续第三年进入总决赛；该队2014年负于雷霆，2015年则击败赫特福德郡小马队夺冠。

en.s: The 2016 Campeonato Paraense final was the final that decided the 2016 Campeonato Paraense, the 104th season of the Campeonato Paraense. The final were contested between Paysandu and São Francisco. Paysandu defeated São Francisco 2–1 to win their 46th Campeonato Paraense title.

zh.s: 2016年帕拉州锦标赛决赛决出该项赛事第104届冠军。帕桑杜队对阵圣弗朗西斯科队，帕桑杜以2比1获胜，夺得队史第46个帕拉州锦标赛冠军。

en.s: The Magyar Kupa final was the final match of the 2015–16 Magyar Kupa, played between Újpest and Ferencváros.

zh.s: 2015—16赛季匈牙利杯决赛由乌伊佩斯特队对阵费伦茨瓦罗斯队。

en.s: The 2016 Welsh Liberal Democrats leadership election took place following the resignation of Kirsty Williams following the 2016 elections to the Welsh Assembly where the Welsh Liberal Democrats fell from five seats to one. Kirsty Williams resigned on 6 May 2016 with Mark Williams being appointed acting leader that evening before being confirmed as leader by the party's National Executive Committee the following day.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2016年威尔士自由民主党党魁选举
zh.s: 威尔士自由民主党党魁克斯蒂·威廉姆斯在2016年威尔士议会选举后辞职；自由民主党的席位从5席减至1席。她于2016年5月6日辞职，当晚马克·威廉姆斯获任代理党魁，次日经该党全国执行委员会确认，正式出任党魁。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in France on 23 April and 7 May 2017. Incumbent president François Hollande of the Socialist Party (PS) was eligible to run for a second term, but declared on 1 December 2016 that he would not seek reelection in light of low approval ratings, making him the first incumbent head of state of the Fifth Republic not to seek reelection.

zh.s: 法国总统选举于2017年4月23日和5月7日举行。社会党现任总统弗朗索瓦·奥朗德本可竞选连任，但由于支持率偏低，他于2016年12月1日宣布不再参选。他因此成为法兰西第五共和国首位放弃竞选连任的在任国家元首。

loc: 德国石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州

en.s: The 2017 Schleswig-Holstein state election was held on 7 May 2017 to elect the members of the Landtag of Schleswig-Holstein. The incumbent government was led by Minister-President Torsten Albig, and consisted of the Social Democratic Party (SPD), The Greens, and the South Schleswig Voters' Association (SSW). The government lost its majority in the election.

zh.t: 2017年石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州议会选举
zh.s: 石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因州于2017年5月7日举行州议会选举。时任州长托斯滕·阿尔比希领导由社会民主党、绿党和南石勒苏益格选民协会组成的联合政府。该政府在选举中失去多数席位。

en.s: The United Kingdom Championship Special was a professional wrestling streaming event produced by the American promotion WWE. The event was filmed on May 7, 2017, and aired on May 19 exclusively on the WWE Network at 8:00 p.m. British Summer Time (3:00 p.m. Eastern Time). The event was held at Epic Studios in Norwich, Norfolk, England and featured the participation of competitors from WWE's United Kingdom division and the 205 Live program.

zh.s: “英国冠军特别赛”是美国摔角推广机构WWE制作的一场职业摔角网络直播赛事。赛事于2017年5月7日在英格兰诺福克郡诺里奇的Epic Studios录制，并于5月19日晚上8时（英国夏令时；美国东部时间下午3时）在WWE Network独家播出。参赛者来自WWE英国部门和“205 Live”节目。

en.t: 2017 FIFA Beach Soccer World Cup final
en.s: The 2017 FIFA Beach Soccer World Cup Final was the last match of the 2017 FIFA Beach Soccer World Cup which took place on May 7, 2017 at the National Beach Soccer Arena in Nassau, the Bahamas.

zh.t: 2017年国际足联沙滩足球世界杯决赛
zh.s: 2017年国际足联沙滩足球世界杯决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛，于2017年5月7日在巴哈马拿骚的国家沙滩足球场举行。

en.s: The 2017 A-League Grand Final was the twelfth A-League Grand Final, and was played on 7 May 2017, at Allianz Stadium in Sydney. The match was contested between Sydney FC and Melbourne Victory who finished the 2016–17 season first and second respectively. This was the third time the teams met in a final, previously playing each other in 2010 and 2015.

zh.t: 2017年澳大利亚足球联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2017年澳大利亚足球联赛总决赛是该联赛第十二场总决赛，于2017年5月7日在悉尼的安联体育场举行。对阵双方是悉尼FC和墨尔本胜利队；两队在2016—17赛季分别排名第一和第二。这是两队第三次在决赛中交手，此前曾于2010年和2015年对阵。

en.s: The UAAP Season 79 Men's Football Final took place on 7 May 2017 at the Rizal Memorial Stadium.It was the final match of the UAAP Season 79 football tournaments of the UAAP Season 79. It was contested between the Ateneo Blue Eagles and the FEU Tamaraws. Ateneo won 1-0, with Jarvey Gayoso's goal at the 39th minute to claim their seventh UAAP Football Championship title.

zh.s: UAAP第79赛季男子足球决赛于2017年5月7日在黎刹纪念体育场举行，是该赛季UAAP足球赛事的最后一场比赛。对阵双方是阿特内奥蓝鹰队和FEU塔玛劳队。阿特内奥以1比0获胜，贾维·加约索在第39分钟进球，帮助球队第七次夺得UAAP足球冠军。

en.s: The Battle of Derna was a military campaign by the Libyan National Army to recapture the city of Derna from the Shura Council of Mujahideen in Derna, which lasted from 7 May 2018 until 12 February 2019. The majority of military operations concluded by 28 June 2018, with the Libyan National Army declaring control of the entire city on that day, despite continued clashes in the old city.

zh.s: 德尔纳战役是利比亚国民军为从德尔纳圣战士协商委员会手中夺回德尔纳市而发动的军事行动，持续时间为2018年5月7日至2019年2月12日。大部分军事行动于2018年6月28日前结束，利比亚国民军当天宣布已控制全城，但老城区仍有零星冲突。

en.s: The 2019 Denver mayoral election was the 2019 edition of the quadrennial elections held to determine the Mayor of the City of Denver, Colorado. The election was held on May 7, 2019. Since no candidate received a majority of votes, a runoff election was held on June 4, 2019, between the two candidates with the most votes, incumbent Mayor Michael Hancock and Jamie Giellis.

zh.s: 2019年丹佛市长选举是每四年举行一次的市长选举，选出科罗拉多州丹佛市市长。投票于2019年5月7日举行。由于没有候选人获得多数票，得票最多的两人——现任市长迈克尔·汉考克和杰米·吉利斯——于2019年6月4日参加决选。

en.s: Lincoln, Nebraska held an election for mayor on May 7, 2019, being preceded by an April 9 general primary. It saw the election of Leirion Gaylor Baird.

zh.t: 2019年内布拉斯加州林肯市市长选举
zh.s: 内布拉斯加州林肯市于2019年5月7日举行市长选举，之前于4月9日举行初选。莱里昂·盖洛·贝尔德当选市长。

en.s: Bellator 258: Archuleta vs. Pettis was a mixed martial arts event produced by Bellator MMA that took place on May 7, 2021 at Mohegan Sun Arena in Uncasville, Connecticut. This fight card is notable for being Anthony Johnson's final fight before his death.

zh.s: Bellator 258：阿尔奇莱塔对阵佩蒂斯是一场由Bellator综合格斗举办的赛事，于2021年5月7日在康涅狄格州昂卡斯维尔的莫希干太阳体育馆举行。这是安东尼·约翰逊去世前参加的最后一场比赛。

loc: 美国亚利桑那州菲尼克斯

en.s: UFC 274: Oliveira vs. Gaethje was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 7, 2022, at the Footprint Center in Phoenix, Arizona, United States.

zh.s: UFC 274：奥利维拉对阵盖奇是一场由终极格斗冠军赛举办的综合格斗赛事，于2022年5月7日在美国亚利桑那州菲尼克斯的Footprint Center举行。

en.s: The 2022 Denton mayoral election was held on May 7, 2022, to elect the mayor of the city of Denton in the U.S. state of Texas. The election was nonpartisan, so both candidates appeared as independent on the ballot. Denton mayors have two-year terms. Incumbent Mayor Gerard Hudspeth won re-election to his second term, defeating mayor pro tempore and at-large city council member Paul Meltzer in the May election by a close four-point margin.

zh.s: 2022年丹顿市长选举于2022年5月7日举行，选出美国得克萨斯州丹顿市市长。选举不设党派，两名候选人均以独立人士身份列入选票。丹顿市长任期两年。现任市长杰拉德·哈德斯佩思击败临时市长兼市议员保罗·梅尔策，连任第二届，得票差距仅4个百分点。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 7 May 2022. Two seats were up for a regularly scheduled vote; Elwick and McIntyre. Simultaneously a by-election was held in the seat of Huon, following the resignation of the incumbent member Bastian Seidel.

zh.t: 2022年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2022年5月7日举行，埃尔威克和麦金泰尔两个席位按计划参加改选。同日，休恩席位还举行了补选，此前该席位在任议员巴斯蒂安·塞德尔辞职。

en.s: The 2022 Coupe de France final was a football match between Nice and Nantes to decide the winner of the 2021–22 Coupe de France, the 105th season of the Coupe de France. Originally scheduled to take place on 8 May at the Stade de France in Saint-Denis, Paris, the final was moved to 7 May in consultation with competing clubs and the broadcasters.

zh.s: 2022年法国杯决赛由尼斯队对阵南特队，决出2021—22赛季、第105届法国杯冠军。决赛原定于5月8日在巴黎圣但尼的法兰西体育场举行，经参赛俱乐部和转播方协商后，改至5月7日。

en.s: The 2022 NWSL Challenge Cup Championship, the final match of the 2022 NWSL Challenge Cup, was contested by North Carolina Courage and Washington Spirit.

zh.t: 2022年美国国家女子足球联赛挑战杯决赛
zh.s: 2022年美国国家女子足球联赛挑战杯决赛由北卡罗来纳勇气队对阵华盛顿精神队，是该届挑战杯的最后一场比赛。

en.s: The New York Indian Film Festival (NYIFF) is an annual film festival that takes place in New York City, and screens films relating to India, the Indian Diaspora, and the work of Indian filmmakers. The festival began in November 2001 and was founded by Aroon Shivdasani and the Indo-American Arts Council. About 40 films are screened, including features films, shorts, documentaries, and animated films.

zh.s: 纽约印度电影节（NYIFF）是一年一度的电影节，在纽约市举行，放映与印度、印度侨民及印度电影人作品有关的影片。电影节于 2001 年 11 月创办，由阿伦·希夫达萨尼和印美艺术委员会共同创立。每届约放映 40 部影片，包括剧情长片、短片、纪录片和动画片。

en.s: On 7 May 2023, the recreational boat Atlantic capsized in Tanur Beach in Tanur, Malappuram, Kerala, India. The incident, on a boat carrying 37 people, caused 22 deaths and 10 injuries, including 11 children.

zh.s: 2023年5月7日，休闲船“Atlantic”号在印度喀拉拉邦马拉普兰县塔努尔海滩附近倾覆。船上载有37人，事故造成22人死亡、10人受伤，其中包括11名儿童。

en.t: 2023 Croatian national minorities councils and representatives elections
en.s: The 2023 Croatian national minorities councils and representatives elections (Croatian: Izbori za članove vijeća i predstavnike nacionalnih manjina) were held on 7 May in certain regional (counties) and local administrative units (municipalities and towns & cities).
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2023年克罗地亚少数民族委员会和代表选举
zh.s: 2023年克罗地亚少数民族委员会和代表选举（克罗地亚语：Izbori za članove vijeća i predstavnike nacionalnih manjina）于5月7日在部分区域（县）和地方行政单位（市镇及城镇）举行。
zh.n: 此条记录的是源信息框所列的首轮日期。

en.s: The 2024 Indiana Democratic presidential primary took place on May 7, 2024, as part of the Democratic Party primaries for the 2024 presidential election. 79 delegates to the Democratic National Convention were allocated in the open primary, with additional 9 unpledged delegates. To make the primary ballot, candidates had to gather at least 500 signatures from each congressional district, for a total of 4,500 signatures.

zh.t: 2024年印第安纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2024年印第安纳州民主党总统初选于2024年5月7日举行，是民主党2024年总统选举初选的一部分。开放式初选分配79名民主党全国代表大会代表，另有9名不受约束的代表。候选人须在每个国会选区征集至少500个签名，合计至少4,500个，才能列入初选选票。

en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Gujarat on 7 May 2024 to elect 26 members of the 18th Lok Sabha. The result of the election was announced on 4 June 2024.

zh.t: 2024年印度大选古吉拉特邦选区
zh.s: 印度于2024年5月7日在古吉拉特邦举行大选，选出第十八届人民院的26名议员。选举结果于2024年6月4日公布。

en.t: 2024 Indian general election in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu on 7 May 2024 to elect two members of the 18th Lok Sabha. These elections are the first to take place in the union territory after it was formed on 2020 with the merger of the union territories of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.

zh.t: 2024年印度大选达德拉-纳加尔哈维利和达曼-第乌选区
zh.s: 印度于2024年5月7日在达德拉-纳加尔哈维利和达曼-第乌举行大选，选出第十八届人民院的两名议员。这是该联邦属地自2020年由达德拉-纳加尔哈维利和达曼-第乌两个联邦属地合并设立以来，首次举行选举。

en.s: The 2024 Indian general election was held in Goa on 7 May 2024 to elect 2 members of the 18th Lok Sabha.

zh.s: 印度于2024年5月7日在果阿邦举行大选，选出第十八届人民院的两名议员。

en.s: The 2024 Indian general election in Assam was held from 19 April to 7 May 2024, to elect 14 members from the state to the 18th Lok Sabha.
en.n: The 2024 Indian general election in Assam was held from 19 April to 7 May 2024, to elect 14 members from the state to the 18th Lok Sabha.

zh.s: 2024年印度大选在阿萨姆邦于2024年4月19日至5月7日举行，选出该邦第十八届人民院的14名议员。
zh.n: 2024年印度大选在阿萨姆邦于2024年4月19日至5月7日举行，选出该邦第十八届人民院的14名议员。

en.s: The 2025 Assam Panchayat Election were held in May 2025. Polling took place in two phases, on 2 and 7 May 2025. The counting of votes started on 11 May and results were declared on 14 May. More than 18 million people were eligible to vote and the voter turnout was over 74 per cent.

zh.s: 阿萨姆邦于2025年5月举行潘查亚特选举，投票分两轮进行，日期为5月2日和7日。计票于5月11日开始，结果于5月14日公布。超过1,800万人有投票资格，投票率超过74%。

en.t: The Indian Army and the Indian Air Force conduct surgical strikes code-named Operation SINDOOR on terrorist hideouts in Pakistan in response to the Pahalgam Attack that killed 26 people
en.s: A brief armed conflict between India and Pakistan began on 7 May 2025, after India launched missile strikes on Pakistan, in a military campaign codenamed Operation Sindoor. India said that the operation was in response to the Pahalgam attack in Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir on 22 April 2025 in which 26 civilians were killed. India accused Pakistan of supporting cross-border terrorism, which Pakistan denied.

zh.t: 印度发动代号“辛杜尔行动”的军事打击
zh.s: 2025年5月7日，印度对巴基斯坦发动导弹袭击，双方因此爆发短暂武装冲突，印度将此次军事行动代号定为“辛杜尔行动”。印度称，行动是为了回应2025年4月22日印控查谟和克什米尔地区帕哈尔加姆袭击事件；该事件造成26名平民死亡。印度指责巴基斯坦支持跨境恐怖主义，巴基斯坦否认这一指控。

en.s: Local elections in the United Kingdom were held on 7 May 2026 for 5,066 English councillors for 136 English local authorities (all 32 London borough councils, 32 metropolitan boroughs, 18 unitary authorities, 6 county councils, 48 district councils) and six directly elected mayors in England. Most of these seats in England were last up for election in 2022. Some of these elections were postponed from 2025.

zh.s: 英国地方选举于2026年5月7日举行。英格兰136个地方政府辖区改选5,066名议员，涉及32个伦敦自治市、32个大都会自治市、18个单一制地方政府、6个郡议会和48个区议会；英格兰还直选6名市长。英格兰这些席位大多上次于2022年改选，部分选举原定于2025年举行，后延期至本次。

en.s: Local elections in London were held on 7 May 2026, as part of the 2026 United Kingdom local elections. All London borough councillor seats were up for election. The election saw major losses for the Labour Party, major gains for the London Green Party, and minor gains for Reform UK, Liberal Democrats and the Conservatives.

zh.s: 2026年伦敦地方选举于5月7日举行，是2026年英国地方选举的一部分。伦敦各自治市议会的所有议员席位都参加改选。工党大幅失利，伦敦绿党大幅增席，英国改革党、自由民主党和保守党小幅增席。

en.s: The 2026 Walsall Council election was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the other local elections across the United Kingdom being held on the same day. This council is divided into 20 wards, with each having 3 councillors. All 60 members of Walsall Council were elected. Prior to the election, the council had been under no overall control since February 2026, when defections saw the Conservatives lose the majority they had previously held.

zh.s: 2026年沃尔索尔市议会选举于5月7日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日。该市议会分为20个选区，每区有3名议员，全部60席都进行改选。2026年2月，保守党议员转投他党，失去多数席位，此后议会一直没有任何政党占多数。

en.t: 2026 Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election
en.s: The 2026 Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election took place on 7 May 2026, as part of the 2026 United Kingdom local elections. The election took place alongside local elections in the other London boroughs. All seats were up for election. The Labour Party retained the Council, but lost 13 seats. Reform UK won 9 seats, its first seats in the borough.

zh.t: 2026年巴金-达格纳姆区议会选举
zh.s: 2026年巴金-达格纳姆区议会选举于5月7日举行，是2026年英国地方选举的一部分，与伦敦其他自治市的地方选举同日进行。所有席位都参加改选。工党继续掌控议会，但失去13席。英国改革党赢得9席，这是该党首次在该自治市赢得席位。
